cells.zh: 公司制（自身上市）：1998年由会员制改制并直接在自己市场挂牌
cells.en: Demutualized, Listed: demutualized in 1998 and listed directly on its own market

cells.zh: 是，自身股票在ASX市场上市交易（股票代码ASX）
cells.en: Yes, ASX Limited itself is listed and trades on its own market (ticker: ASX)

cells.zh: 澳元
cells.en: AUD

cells.zh: 澳元
cells.en: AUD

cells.zh: 澳大利亚证券及投资委员会（ASIC）
cells.en: Australian Securities and Investments Commission (ASIC)

cells.zh: ASX自身（一线监管，负责监督上市实体遵守《上市规则》、参与者遵守《运营规则》）
cells.en: ASX itself (front-line regulation of listed entities under the Listing Rules and participants under the Operating Rules)

cells.zh: 《公司法2001》（Corporations Act 2001 (Cth)），市场牌照见其Part 7.2、清算结算牌照见Part 7.3
cells.en: Corporations Act 2001 (Cth); market licensing under Part 7.2, clearing & settlement facility licensing under Part 7.3

cells.zh: 开盘单一价格集合竞价（OSPA），09:59:00起随机15秒窗口触发，最早09:59:45转入连续交易
cells.en: Opening Single Price Auction (OSPA), triggered within a randomised 15-second window from 09:59:00, earliest transition to continuous trading at 09:59:45

cells.zh: 收盘单一价格集合竞价（CSPA），16:10起随机30秒窗口触发，16:11收盘
cells.en: Closing Single Price Auction (CSPA), triggered within a randomised 30-second window from 16:10, closing at 16:11

cells.zh: 订单驱动：ASX Trade 为中央电子订单簿，按价格优先、时间优先连续自动撮合；现货股票不设做市商。ETF / 权证等投资产品发行人须履行流动性支持（做市）义务，衍生品市场另设正式做市商注册制度
cells.en: Order-driven: ASX Trade is a central electronic order book matching continuously on price-then-time priority; cash equities have no market makers. Issuers of investment products (ETFs / warrants) must meet liquidity-support obligations under the AQUA / Warrant Rules, and the derivatives market has a separate formal Market Maker registration scheme

cells.zh: 价格优先、时间优先，连续竞价阶段由ASX Trade系统自动持续撮合
cells.en: Price/time priority, continuously matched automatically by the ASX Trade system during continuous trading

cells.zh: 限价单、市转限单（Market-To-Limit）、扫单（Sweep Market-To-Limit）、冰山单（Iceberg Order，最低披露 500 单位）、全隐藏单（Undisclosed Order）、Centre Point 中点订单系列（盯住买卖中点的暗盘 / 块单）
cells.en: Limit Order, Market-To-Limit Order, Sweep Market-To-Limit Order, Iceberg Order (minimum disclosed portion 500 units), Undisclosed Order (fully hidden), and Centre Point orders (dark orders pegged to the bid/offer midpoint, including block orders)

cells.zh: 无逐日涨跌幅限制；改用订单级异常订单阈值机制（AOT）作为价格保护手段
cells.en: No daily price limit band; ASX instead uses order-level Anomalous Order Thresholds (AOT) as a price safeguard

cells.zh: 无每日涨跌停幅度（见 type 字段的 AOT 说明）
cells.en: No daily price limit band (see the AOT note in the type field)

cells.zh: ASX不使用其他国际交易所常见的熔断机制；ASIC统一制定的市场诚信规则(MIR)改用AOT取代熔断
cells.en: ASX does not use circuit breakers as employed by some other international exchanges; ASIC's Market Integrity Rules substitute AOTs for circuit breakers

cells.zh: 极端成交区间机制（ETR）：成交价触及每只股票各自设定的区间即暂停该股交易2分钟，与AOT搭配构成组合机制
cells.en: Extreme Trade Range (ETR) mechanism: trading in an individual stock is paused for two minutes if price triggers that stock's own ETR band, working alongside AOT

cells.zh: 上市实体可申请交易暂停（trading halt），须说明理由、期望时长及触发恢复交易的预期事件；单次暂停不得超过申请后第二个交易日正常交易开始，ASX亦可依职权在无序市场时强制暂停
cells.en: A listed entity may request a trading halt, stating its reasons, desired duration and the expected triggering event for resumption; a single halt cannot exceed the commencement of normal trading on the second trading day after it is requested; ASX may also impose halts on its own initiative to prevent a disorderly market

cells.zh: 未见针对当日回转交易（先买后卖）的结构性限制，交易层面近似T+0
cells.en: No structural restriction on intraday buy-then-sell found in materials reviewed; effectively T+0 at the trading level

cells.zh: 覆盖式卖空（covered short selling）合法且受《公司法》认可为价格发现与流动性的正当机制，须遵守披露义务；裸卖空（naked short selling）除ASIC个别豁免情形外一律禁止；覆盖式卖空须于次一交易日上午9点前向市场运营商报告
cells.en: Covered short selling is legal and recognised under the Corporations Act as a legitimate mechanism for price discovery and liquidity, subject to disclosure obligations; naked short selling is prohibited except where ASIC has granted relief; covered short sales must be reported to the market operator by 9am on the next trading day

cells.zh: ETF/权证等投资产品发行人须依AQUA/Warrant规则履行流动性支持（做市）义务；衍生品市场另设正式的做市商注册制度
cells.en: Issuers of investment products (ETFs/warrants) must meet liquidity support (market making) obligations under the AQUA/Warrant Rules; the derivatives market has a separate formal Market Maker registration scheme

cells.zh: 披露为本的准入审核制度：满足量化门槛（利润或资产二选一）+股东分布/自由流通量要求即可申请，ASX对适合性另有实质审核权，不完全对应注册制/核准制的二分
cells.en: Disclosure-based admission regime: applicants meeting quantitative thresholds (profit or assets test) plus spread/free-float requirements may apply; ASX retains substantive discretion over suitability, not a clean fit for the registration-based/approval-based dichotomy

cells.zh: ASX可依职权将实体从官方上市名单移除，主要情形包括：实体无法或不愿遵守上市规则、已无任何报价证券，或ASX认为存在其他合理理由
cells.en: ASX may remove an entity from the official list where, in ASX's opinion: the entity is unable or unwilling to comply with a Listing Rule, has no quoted securities, or removal is appropriate for some other reason

cells.zh: T+2（自2016年起实行）。此后ASX成立T+1工作组研究进一步压缩至T+1的可行性，2024年4月23日发布行业白皮书；官方页面明确称之为「潜在改革」，处于征求行业反馈阶段，未见官方确认的正式切换日期
cells.en: T+2, in effect since 2016. ASX has since run a T+1 Working Group studying a further move to T+1, publishing an industry whitepaper on 23 April 2024; the official page explicitly describes this as a 'potential' change under industry consultation, with no confirmed transition date found

cells.zh: ASX Clear（现货市场证券/权证/结构性产品/计息证券的中央对手方）
cells.en: ASX Clear (central counterparty for equities, warrants, structured products and interest rate securities)

cells.zh: ASX Settlement，透过结算与股权分登记电子系统（CHESS）运作
cells.en: ASX Settlement, operating via the Clearing House Electronic Sub-register System (CHESS)

cells.zh: 不适用（现货市场为主）
cells.en: N/A (predominantly a cash/spot market)

cells.zh: ASX 对现货市场成交本身收取成交费（Trade Fee）；以股票为例，按成交金额 0.15 基点从价计收，每笔每边封顶 75 澳元。其余产品类别适用不同档费率，均按月计收并加收 GST
cells.en: ASX charges a Trade Fee on the cash-market trade itself; for equities it is 0.15 basis points of traded value, capped at $75 per trade per side. Other product categories use different fee tiers, all charged monthly plus GST

cells.zh: 澳大利亚各州已废除上市证券（marketable securities，含 ASX 上市股票）转让的印花税（含交易单据印花税）。以新南威尔士州为例，《1997 年税收法》(Duties Act 1997) 第 34 条自 2016 年 7 月 1 日起规定「marketable securities … are not dutiable property」，各州亦先后废除对上市股票的印花税；因此 ASX 二级市场交易目前不产生州印花税。土地持有型公司（landholder）的股份转让等特定情形仍可能触地相关税，属例外
cells.en: Australian states have abolished stamp duty on transfer of marketable securities (including ASX-listed shares). In New South Wales, for example, s34 of the Duties Act 1997 provides that from 1 July 2016 marketable securities 'are not dutiable property'; other states likewise abolished duty on listed shares. ASX secondary-market trades therefore currently incur no state stamp duty. Transfers of shares in landholder companies remain a possible exception caught by land-related duty

cells.zh: 公司制（自身上市）：B3普通股在自己管理的Novo Mercado板块挂牌交易
cells.en: Demutualized, listed on its own market (Novo Mercado governance segment)

cells.zh: 是：B3自身股票（代码B3SA3）在自己管理的市场上市，属于Novo Mercado治理板块——与港交所自身股票在自己主板挂牌的模式相同，都不同于NYSE「母公司反向在自己交易所上市」的结构
cells.en: Yes: B3's own shares (ticker B3SA3) are listed on its own market, in the Novo Mercado governance segment — the same direction as HKEX (self-listed on own main board), unlike NYSE where the parent company is listed on the exchange it doesn't itself trade on

cells.zh: 巴西雷亚尔 (BRL)
cells.en: BRL

cells.zh: 巴西雷亚尔 (BRL)
cells.en: BRL

cells.zh: 巴西证券交易委员会（Comissão de Valores Mobiliários, CVM）
cells.en: Brazilian Securities and Exchange Commission (CVM)

cells.zh: BSM Supervisão de Mercados（B3集团旗下的自律监管子机构）
cells.en: BSM Supervisão de Mercados

cells.zh: 《6.385号法律》（Lei 6.385/76，1976年12月7日颁布）——CVM官网现行「Sobre a CVM」（关于CVM）页面官方原文确认：该法律创设了CVM（巴西证券委员会），赋予其监管、规范、纪律处分与发展巴西证券市场的职能
cells.en: Law No. 6.385/76 (enacted 7 December 1976) — CVM's own current 'Sobre a CVM' (About CVM) page states the law created the CVM (Brazil's securities commission), tasked with supervising, regulating, disciplining, and developing the Brazilian securities market

cells.zh: 开盘集合竞价（Opening Call）：09:45–10:00为盘前阶段，只挂单不成交，用于形成开盘理论价格
cells.en: Opening Call: the 09:45–10:00 pre-opening phase accepts order entry without matching, used to form the theoretical opening price

cells.zh: 收盘集合竞价（Closing Call）：16:55–17:00
cells.en: Closing Call: 16:55–17:00

cells.zh: 混合模式：PUMA 为中央电子订单簿，按价格优先、报单时间顺序连续撮合；同时设正式做市商制度，分独立做市商、参与 B3 计划的独立做市商、受托做市商三类注册，投资基金也可注册为独立做市商，获批后须在 30 日内开始履约
cells.en: Hybrid: PUMA is a central electronic order book matching on price priority then chronological order of entry, running alongside a formal market-maker regime with three registration categories (independent, B3-programme independent, and contracted market makers); investment funds may also register, and a registered market maker must begin acting within 30 days of approval

cells.zh: 连续交易按价格优先、报单先后时间顺序（chronological order of entry）撮合；集合竞价按能匹配最大成交量的价格确定理论价，价格相同再依失衡量最小与最近成交价接近程度决胜
cells.en: Continuous trading matches on price priority and chronological order of entry; auctions determine the theoretical price as the one matching the largest quantity, with ties broken by the smallest resulting imbalance and proximity to the last traded price

cells.zh: 市价单、限价单、管理单（Managed Order）、竞争性管理单、自由裁量单（Discretionary Order）、联动单（Funding Order）、止损单（Stop Order）、配对单（Matched Order）八种基础类型；另有开盘市价单(MOA)、收盘市价单(MOC)、收盘限价单(LOC)等特殊撮合期订单，以及GTC/GTD等有效期修饰符
cells.en: Eight base order types: Market, Limit, Managed, Competing Managed, Discretionary, Funding, Stop, and Matched orders; plus auction-specific types Market-on-Auction (MOA), Market-on-Close (MOC), Limit-on-Close (LOC), and time-in-force qualifiers such as GTC/GTD

cells.zh: 动态「交易隧道」（trading tunnels）机制：以最新成交价/最优报价等推导出的基准价（PBT，tunnel base price）为中心，用加法或乘法方式计算带宽，动态限制申报价与成交价区间，而非固定百分比涨跌停
cells.en: Dynamic 'trading tunnels' mechanism: bands computed additively or multiplicatively around a tunnel base price (PBT) derived from the last trade price / best bid-ask, rather than a fixed daily percentage limit

cells.zh: 无固定百分比涨跌停；动态「交易隧道」，具体带宽逐品种由 B3 官网维护（见 type 字段）
cells.en: No fixed percentage limit band; dynamic 'trading tunnels' with per-instrument bandwidths maintained by B3 (see the type field)

cells.zh: 指数级熔断：以Ibovespa较前一交易日收盘的跌幅触发，分三档——跌10%暂停全市场交易30分钟；恢复后再跌15%暂停1小时；恢复后再跌20%由B3自行决定暂停时长并公告
cells.en: Index-level circuit breaker triggered by Ibovespa's decline from the prior close, in three stages: -10% halts all trading for 30 minutes; upon resumption, -15% halts trading for 1 hour; upon resumption, -20% lets B3 determine and announce the suspension period

cells.zh: 品种级的「拍卖隧道」（auction tunnel）机制：撮合价若将突破基于最近成交价动态计算的价格区间，系统不直接成交，而是自动触发一次集合竞价
cells.en: Instrument-level 'auction tunnel' mechanism: when a prospective trade price would breach the dynamically computed band around the last traded price, the system does not execute directly but automatically triggers an auction

cells.zh: 除熔断与隧道机制外，若发行人在交易时段内发布或即将发布重大事项公告，B3按公告发生的时点分五档窗口（如9:15前/9:15–9:29/9:30–9:59/10:00–16:09/16:10–16:49），分别延后撤单阶段、开盘集合竞价，或直接暂停交易20分钟后再进行撤单与重新开盘拍卖
cells.en: Beyond circuit breakers and tunnels, if an issuer publishes or is about to publish a material-event notice during a session, B3 applies a tiered procedure across five time windows that postpones order-cancellation phases and the opening call, or suspends trading for 20 minutes followed by an order-cancellation phase and a reopening auction

cells.zh: T+0：允许当日回转交易（day trade）；B3自身税务页面把「Day trade」列为独立的操作类别，交易所层面未见限制次日才可卖出的规则
cells.en: T+0: same-day round-trip (day) trading is permitted; B3's own taxation page lists 'Day trade' as a distinct operation category, and no exchange-level rule requiring next-day resale was found

cells.zh: 存在证券出借/融券安排使做空成为可能（官网设「Securities Lending, Equity and ETF Trades」专栏），但本次抓取到的该页面正文只包含股票/ETF的代码、整手规格与结算周期，没有描述性正文说明具体限制规则（如是否有报升限制、裸卖空处理等），仅能确认功能入口存在
cells.en: A securities lending facility exists that enables short selling (the site has a page titled 'Securities Lending, Equity and ETF Trades'), but the content actually fetched on that page only covers ticker format, round-lot size and settlement period for stocks/ETFs — no descriptive text on specific restrictions (e.g. any uptick rule, treatment of naked short selling) was found; only the existence of the facility is confirmed

cells.zh: 分独立做市商、参与B3计划的独立做市商、受托做市商（Contracted Market Maker）三类注册；投资基金也可注册为独立做市商；获批后须在30日内开始履约，具体资产/衍生品可容纳的做市商数量上限由B3设定
cells.en: Three registration categories: independent market makers, independent market makers accredited for B3 programs, and contracted market makers; investment funds may also register as independent market makers; once approved, a market maker must begin acting within 30 days, and B3 caps the maximum number of market makers per asset/derivative

cells.zh: 发行人证券的挂牌/交易许可由B3依《发行人规则》（Issuer's Regulations）受理审核，另须完成CVM的「公众公司」注册
cells.en: Admission of an issuer's securities to trading is handled by B3 under the Issuer's Regulations, alongside separate registration as a public company with CVM

cells.zh: 退出治理板块（segment exit）或注销登记须发起强制公开要约收购（Public Tender Offer）；要约价格与最低受约比例因板块而异，例如Novo Mercado要求至少公允价格、且须获得至少1/3流通股股东接受
cells.en: Exiting a governance segment or deregistering requires a mandatory Public Tender Offer; the offer price and minimum acceptance threshold vary by segment — e.g. Novo Mercado requires at least fair value and acceptance by at least 1/3 of free-float shareholders

cells.zh: T+2（现货证券市场，2019年5月27日起从T+3缩短为T+2）
cells.en: T+2 (cash equities market; shortened from T+3, effective May 27, 2019)

cells.zh: B3 Clearinghouse（B3自身内设的中央对手方职能，非独立法人清算所）；外汇交易另由B3 Foreign Exchange Clearinghouse担任对手方
cells.en: B3 Clearinghouse (an in-house CCP function of B3 itself, not a separately incorporated clearing entity); FX trades are separately cleared by the B3 Foreign Exchange Clearinghouse

cells.zh: B3中央证券存管（B3's central securities depository），同样是B3自身内设机构而非独立法人——与美股DTCC作为独立法人清算所的模式不同
cells.en: B3's central securities depository — again an in-house function of B3 rather than a separately incorporated entity, unlike the DTCC model in the US

cells.zh: 现货证券市场为「资金+证券」过户交收，不适用衍生品意义上的实物/现金交割二选一；衍生品部分另见 clearing.derivatives.delivery_method
cells.en: The cash equities market settles via funds-versus-securities transfer — not a derivatives-style physical-vs-cash delivery choice; for derivatives see clearing.derivatives.delivery_method

cells.zh: 按成交总金额收取一定比例的交易所费用（Exchange Fees），费率依交易类型（常规交易/超短线日内交易）、投资者类别（个人/基金/投资俱乐部）与投资金额分档
cells.en: Exchange Fees are charged as a percentage of total traded volume, varying by trade type (regular vs. very-short-term day trades), investor category (individual/funds/investment clubs), and amount invested

cells.zh: 巴西不对证券交易征收类似英国/香港式的印花税（stamp duty）；证券流转环节的类交易税为IOF（金融操作税，股票资金汇入当前为0%）与所得税。该字段对B3适用情形为N/A。
cells.en: Brazil levies no UK/Hong-Kong-style stamp duty on securities trades; the transaction-style levies on securities are IOF (Financial Transaction Tax, currently 0% on equity inflows) and income tax. This field is N/A for B3.

cells.zh: 公司制（1999年起改制，结束会员制）；现属 TMX Group Limited 集团架构，集团层面公开交易
cells.en: Demutualized (member ownership ended starting 1999); now part of the publicly traded TMX Group Limited

cells.zh: 并非TSX Inc.实体本身上市，而是其母公司TMX Group Limited在TSX自身挂牌交易（股票代码 X）
cells.en: Not TSX Inc. itself; parent TMX Group Limited is listed on TSX itself (ticker X)

cells.zh: 加元（CAD）为主，另有以美元（USD）计价的双重货币挂牌证券（代码以「.U」结尾）
cells.en: Primarily CAD; also USD-denominated dual-currency listings (symbols ending in ".U")

cells.zh: 与交易货币一致：加元为主，USD计价证券以美元结算
cells.en: Same as trading currency: primarily CAD; USD-denominated securities settle in USD

cells.zh: 安大略省证券委员会（Ontario Securities Commission, OSC）
cells.en: Ontario Securities Commission (OSC)

cells.zh: 加拿大投资监管组织（Canadian Investment Regulatory Organization, CIRO）
cells.en: Canadian Investment Regulatory Organization (CIRO)

cells.zh: 《安大略省证券法》（Securities Act, R.S.O. 1990, c. S.5）
cells.en: Securities Act, R.S.O. 1990, c. S.5 (Ontario)

cells.zh: 开盘集合竞价（Market on Open, MOO），9:30am，所有可撮合订单以单一开盘价成交，未成交剩余订单（Limit on Open订单除外）转入连续限价订单簿
cells.en: Market on Open (MOO) auction at 9:30 a.m.; all matching orders execute at a single opening trade price, with unfilled residuals (except Limit on Open orders) carried into the continuous limit order book

cells.zh: 收盘集合竞价（Market on Close, MOC），4:00pm；若计算收盘价（CCP）超出价格波动延展（PME）范围，触发4:00-4:10pm价格波动延展期重新计算；TSX的PME参数为3%或5个最小报价单位（取较大者），收盘价接受度（CPA）参数为10%
cells.en: Market on Close (MOC) auction at 4:00 p.m.; if the Calculated Closing Price (CCP) exceeds the Price Movement Extension (PME) range, a 4:00–4:10 p.m. PME period is triggered to recalculate; for TSX the PME parameter is 3% or five trading increments (whichever is greater), with a 10% Closing Price Acceptance (CPA) parameter

cells.zh: 混合模式：电子中央限价订单簿（CLOB）连续撮合，叠加正式做市商制度——经批准的 Market Maker Firm 为其负责证券（Securities of Responsibility）维持公平、有序、连续的双向市场，由 Registered Trader 代表履行日常义务，并处理碎股自动执行
cells.en: Hybrid: an electronic central limit order book (CLOB) with continuous matching, overlaid with a formal market-maker regime — an approved Market Maker Firm maintains a fair, orderly and continuous two-sided market in its Securities of Responsibility, carried out day-to-day by a Registered Trader who also handles Odd Lot auto-execution

cells.zh: 电子连续限价订单簿（CLOB）撮合；同一经纪商的双方挂单可触发「经纪商优先撮合」（Broker Preferencing），不受订单簿原有排序位置限制，Jitney单与匿名单不适用此优先机制
cells.en: Electronic Central Limit Order Book (CLOB) matching; Broker Preferencing lets an incoming attributed order match another attributed order from the same broker regardless of order-book position, though Jitney and Anonymous orders are excluded

cells.zh: 限价单、市价单、冰山单（Iceberg）、暗盘单（Dark Pegged/Dark Limit）、绕过标记单（Bypass）、待触发单（On-Stop）等；另有MOC/LOC（Limit on Close）等收盘专用订单
cells.en: Limit Order, Market Order, Iceberg Order, Dark Order (Dark Pegged/Dark Limit), Bypass Marker, On-Stop Order, plus closing-specific MOC/LOC (Limit on Close) orders

cells.zh: 非固定百分比/绝对值幅，而是以「Marketplace Threshold」（围绕National Last Sale Price动态计算的价格偏离限制）与「Bid/Ask Tick Limit」（按报价分层的穿透档位限制）两套机制组合构成的动态价格带
cells.en: Not a fixed percentage/absolute band; combines dynamic "Marketplace Threshold" price-deviation limits around the National Last Sale Price with tiered "Bid/Ask Tick Limit" sweep-depth limits
Bid/Ask Tick Limit tiers by starting price: 0.10 ticks from $0.00, 0.25 from $1.00, 0.50 from $5.00, 1.00 from $50.00, 5.00 from $100.00 (equities; debentures flat at 5.00)

cells.zh: 全市场熔断（Market-Wide Circuit Breaker），三级阈值：一级7%（暂停15分钟）、二级13%（暂停15分钟）、三级20%（当日剩余时间停市）；基准为标普500指数，美股休市时改用标普/多伦多综指（S&P/TSX Composite Index）；由CIRO统一监管跨市场协调停牌
cells.en: Market-Wide Circuit Breaker with three levels: Level 1 at 7% (15-min halt), Level 2 at 13% (15-min halt), Level 3 at 20% (halts trading for the remainder of the day); benchmarked to the S&P 500, switching to the S&P/TSX Composite Index when U.S. markets are closed; coordinated cross-market halt regulated by CIRO

cells.zh: 个股熔断机制（Single Stock Circuit Breaker, SSCB）：5分钟内价格波动达10%以上，跨全体加拿大市场自动触发该股票5分钟停牌；停牌前触发价外5%以上的成交事后撤销；初期适用范围为标普/多伦多综指成份股及以其为主要持仓的ETF
cells.en: Single Stock Circuit Breakers (SSCB): a 10%-or-more price swing within a 5-minute period automatically triggers a 5-minute halt in that security across all Canadian marketplaces; trades executed more than 5% beyond the triggering price are cancelled; initially applies to S&P/TSX Composite Index constituents and ETFs comprised principally of listed securities

cells.zh: 分两类：「No Matching Halt」（多因监管方就发行人新闻等待发布施加，订单可挂但不撮合）与「Full Halt」（挂单/改单/撮合全部暂停，仍可撤单）；Rule Book另规定非本所上市证券（Other Securities）在受监管停牌或其上市所停牌时同步停牌
cells.en: Two types: "No Matching Halt" (typically imposed by regulators pending issuer news, orders may be entered but not matched) and "Full Halt" (order entry, amendment and matching all suspended, though cancellations remain allowed); the Rule Book separately requires TSX to halt an unlisted "Other Security" if it is subject to a regulatory halt or suspended by its home exchange

cells.zh: 交易层面为 T+0（当日买入的证券当日即可卖出）——TSX Rule Book 与 Order Types and Functionality Guide 通篇只规范订单类型、撮合与交收，未设任何持有期或「交收前不得卖出」限制；结算层面为 T+1（见 clearing.settlement_cycle）
cells.en: T+0 at the trading level (securities bought during the day may be sold the same day) — the TSX Rule Book and the Order Types and Functionality Guide govern only order types, matching and settlement, with no holding-period or "may not sell before settlement" restriction; settlement is T+1 (see clearing.settlement_cycle)

cells.zh: TSX规则手册本身已于2002年废除卖空定义与规则条款，相关卖空规则现由CIRO制定并统一执行的UMIR（Universal Market Integrity Rules）规范，非TSX自订；UMIR具体的卖空限制条款（如是否有报升规则）本次未能核实，见 OPEN-QUESTIONS
cells.en: TSX's own Rule Book repealed its short-sale definition and rules in 2002; short-selling conduct is instead governed by CIRO's Universal Market Integrity Rules (UMIR), not TSX-specific rules; the substantive current UMIR short-selling regime was not verifiable this session, see OPEN-QUESTIONS

cells.zh: 做市商制度：经批准的「Market Maker Firm」为其负责证券（Securities of Responsibility）维持公平有序双向市场，由「Registered Trader」代表履行日常义务，兼管碎股自动执行
cells.en: Market Maker scheme: approved Market Maker Firms maintain a fair, orderly two-sided market in their assigned Securities of Responsibility, carried out day-to-day by a Registered Trader, who also handles Odd Lot auto-execution

cells.zh: 披露为本，按发行人类型（Income & Revenue-Producing / Pre Income-Producing / New Enterprise / Mining / Oil and Gas Companies）分设量化上市资格路径，由TSX自行审核并须符合OSC核准的Company Manual规则
cells.en: Disclosure-based; TSX applies distinct quantitative eligibility tracks by issuer type (Income & Revenue-Producing / Pre Income-Producing / New Enterprise / Mining / Oil and Gas Companies), reviewed by TSX itself under OSC-approved Company Manual rules

cells.zh: 以Diversified Issuers为例：总资产低于$3,000,000或最近年度经营性收入低于$3,000,000（研发型发行人改用研发支出$1,000,000门槛）；另有违反上市协议（Listing Agreement）、未满足对应类别管理层要求等一般性退市事由
cells.en: For Diversified Issuers: total assets below $3,000,000 or annual operating revenue below $3,000,000 in the most recent year (R&D issuers instead face a $1,000,000 R&D-spend threshold); general grounds also include breach of the Listing Agreement or failure to meet category-specific management requirements

cells.zh: T+1（现行规则为「交易日后第一个结算日」；2024年5月27日前后该规则区块被修订/废除多项例外条款，与北美市场整体从T+2改为T+1的时点吻合）
cells.en: T+1 (current rule reads "the first Settlement Day after the trade date"; several exception provisions in the same rule area were repealed/amended around May 27, 2024, matching the broader North American T+2-to-T+1 migration date)

cells.zh: CDS Clearing and Depository Services Inc.
cells.en: CDS Clearing and Depository Services Inc.

cells.zh: 加拿大证券存管公司（The Canadian Depository for Securities Limited, CDS）
cells.en: The Canadian Depository for Securities Limited (CDS)

cells.zh: 不适用（现货市场，无实物/现金交割概念）
cells.en: Not applicable (cash market; no physical/cash delivery concept)

cells.zh: 做市商-吃单者模式（maker-taker）：以非美元计价、非跨挂牌股票为例，主动吃单费约每股$0.0027（$1及以上价位），提供流动性一方获返佣约每股$0.0023；不同价位/品类（跨挂牌股票、ETF、低价股）费率分层
cells.en: Maker-taker pricing model: for example, non-interlisted equities priced at $1.00 or above are charged roughly $0.0027/share for removing displayed liquidity, with a roughly $0.0023/share rebate for providing it; rates are further tiered by price level and security type (interlisted equities, ETFs, sub-$1 stocks)

cells.zh: 不适用：加拿大对证券转让不征收印花税（stamp duty）。跨境并购税务指南明确指出「There is no stamp duty in Canada」；联邦无证券交易印花税，各省印花税一般也不适用于证券交易所上市证券的转让
cells.en: Not applicable: Canada imposes no stamp duty on the transfer of securities. A cross-border M&A guide states plainly 'There is no stamp duty in Canada'; there is no federal securities-transfer stamp duty, and provincial stamp duties generally do not apply to transfers of exchange-listed securities

cells.zh: 公司制（未上市）——SIX Swiss Exchange AG是股份公司（Aktiengesellschaft），由约120家瑞士及国际金融机构作为股东持有，自身未挂牌上市
cells.en: Corporate form, unlisted — SIX Swiss Exchange AG is a stock corporation (Aktiengesellschaft) whose shares are held by around 120 Swiss and international financial institutions as owners; it is not itself listed

cells.zh: 否，SIX Swiss Exchange AG自身未上市
cells.en: No, SIX Swiss Exchange AG itself is not listed

cells.zh: 瑞士法郎（CHF）为主；另有欧元、美元等外币计价品种（如非瑞郎债券「Bonds - Non CHF」、部分结构性产品与ETF）
cells.en: Primarily Swiss francs (CHF); certain products are denominated in other currencies (e.g. the "Bonds - Non CHF" segment, and some structured products and ETFs)

cells.zh: 与交易货币一致，按品种计价货币结算
cells.en: Same as trading currency; settled in the currency each instrument is denominated in

cells.zh: 瑞士金融市场监管局（FINMA）——终局监管权；另有瑞士国家银行（SNB）对系统重要性基础设施（含SIX x-clear）的监测
cells.en: Swiss Financial Market Supervisory Authority (FINMA) — ultimate supervisory authority; the Swiss National Bank (SNB) additionally monitors systemically important infrastructure (including SIX x-clear)

cells.zh: SIX Exchange Regulation（SER）——依《证券交易法》自律监管授权设立的独立实体，与SIX集团运营业务分离，直接向SIX董事会主席报告
cells.en: SIX Exchange Regulation (SER) — an independent entity established under the self-regulatory mandate of the Stock Exchange Act, segregated from SIX's operational business and reporting directly to the Chairman of the Board of Directors of SIX

cells.zh: 《联邦金融市场基础设施与证券衍生品交易市场行为法》（FinMIA/FMIA）
cells.en: Federal Act on Financial Market Infrastructures and Market Conduct in Securities and Derivatives Trading (FinMIA / FMIA)

cells.zh: 开盘集合竞价，随机时间窗口2分钟；按「最大可执行数量原则」确定开盘价，价格-时间优先原则下限价与不限价申报均纳入撮合
cells.en: Opening auction with a 2-minute random time window; the opening price is determined according to the "principle of highest executable volume", with orders considered under price-time priority

cells.zh: 收盘集合竞价（17:20起始，17:30随机窗口内完成），蓝筹股/中小盘股另有17:30-17:40的Trading-At-Last盘后交易期，以收盘价继续撮合
cells.en: Closing auction (starts 17:20, completes within a random window around 17:30); Blue Chip and Mid-/Small-Cap Shares additionally have a Trading-At-Last period 17:30-17:40 that continues matching at the closing price

cells.zh: 混合模式：中央电子限价订单簿、价格-时间优先连续撮合；同时设正式做市商制度——做市商须与交易所签订书面 Market Maker Agreement，按所在细分市场承担持续报价覆盖率与最大点差义务（蓝筹股要求月均 80% 以上交易时段维持不超过 2.5% 的最大点差）
cells.en: Hybrid: a central electronic limit order book matching on price-then-time priority, with a formal market-maker regime — market makers sign a written Market Maker Agreement with the Exchange and take on quoting-coverage and maximum-spread obligations by segment (Blue Chip Shares require quoting over 80% of trading hours on a monthly average with a maximum spread of 2.5%)

cells.zh: 价格-时间优先原则：更优价格（买方最高限价、卖方最低限价）优先成交，不限价申报优先于限价申报，同价按接收先后顺序成交；集合竞价另按「最大可执行数量原则」确定单一成交价
cells.en: Price-time priority: the order/quote with the better price (highest limit for buy side, lowest for sell side) is executed first, unlimited orders enjoy top priority, and orders at the same price are executed in order of receipt; auctions additionally apply the "principle of highest executable volume" to determine a single auction price

cells.zh: Normal order（普通订单，限价/不限价）；Iceberg order（冰山订单，逐笔披露可见数量）；Retail order（零售触发订单，含Stop Limit/Stop Loss两类，触发前不进入订单簿）；Auction Volume Discovery order（集合竞价隐藏订单，仅用于开/收盘竞价按数量-时间优先撮合）
cells.en: Normal order (limited or unlimited price); Iceberg order (discloses only a visible tranche at a time); Retail order (trigger-based, not visible pre-trigger, with Stop Limit / Stop Loss variants); Auction Volume Discovery order (hidden order used only in opening/closing auctions, matched under quantity-time priority)

cells.zh: 动态参考价区间——预期后续成交价偏离当前参考价超出阈值即触发交易中断（Trading Interruption），而非直接禁止申报的固定涨跌停
cells.en: Dynamic reference-price range — trading is interrupted once the potential subsequent execution price deviates from the current reference price beyond a threshold, rather than orders being flatly barred by a fixed daily limit

cells.zh: 蓝筹股（Annex A）：偏离参考价±1.5%触发5分钟交易中断（另有10秒内价格骤变的Avalanche Stop机制，同阈值）
cells.en: Blue Chip Shares (Annex A): a ±1.5% deviation from the reference price triggers a 5-minute trading interruption (an Avalanche Stop for rapid moves within 10 seconds applies the same threshold)

cells.zh: 无独立于个股级波动性中断之外、按指数跌幅自动触发的全市场熔断；极端情形下交易所依《交易规则》「非常规情形」/「紧急情形」条款拥有自由裁量权，可延迟开盘、限制/暂停个股连续交易、拒绝或删除订单，乃至暂停部分规则
cells.en: No automatic market-wide circuit breaker triggered by index-level declines, separate from the per-security Volatility Interruption; in extreme situations the Exchange has discretionary powers under the Trading Rules' "Extraordinary situations" / "Emergency situations" provisions to delay openings, restrict or suspend continuous trading in a security, reject or delete orders, or even suspend rules in part

cells.zh: 见price_limits——本所以「Trading Interruption」（交易中断）统一处理开盘延时与盘中波动，按细分市场设不同带宽（蓝筹股±1.5%/5分钟，中小盘股±2%/15分钟或5分钟，波动股±10%/5分钟），交易所可按短期通知调整参数
cells.en: See price_limits — the Exchange uses a unified "Trading Interruption" mechanism for both delayed openings and intraday volatility, with bandwidths varying by segment (Blue Chip ±1.5%/5min; Mid-/Small-Cap ±2%/15min or 5min; volatile securities ±10%/5min); the Exchange may adjust these parameters at short notice

cells.zh: 交易中断后，交易所以「随机结束时间30秒内」重新开盘（集合竞价方式恢复交易）
cells.en: After a trading interruption, the Exchange reopens trading via an auction with a random end within 30 seconds

cells.zh: 交易层面为 T+0（当日买入的证券当日即可卖出）——SIX Swiss Exchange Rule Book 只在 Part III 规范 T+2 清算交收，未设持有期或「交收前不得卖出」限制；其交收失败条款还专门处理「卖出方未持有证券」的情形（以 buy-in 而非禁止申报应对），可见交收前卖出属规则预期内的常态。结算层面为 T+2（见 clearing.settlement_cycle）
cells.en: T+0 at the trading level (securities bought during the day may be sold the same day) — the SIX Swiss Exchange Rule Book regulates only T+2 clearing and settlement in Part III, with no holding-period or 'may not sell before settlement' restriction; its settlement-fail provisions even address a selling participant that 'does not hold the securities' via buy-in rather than by barring the order, implying that selling before settlement is contemplated as normal. Settlement is T+2 (see clearing.settlement_cycle)

cells.zh: 允许卖空，无需事先借券锁定；卖方须在成交时点即完成结算安排（与交收责任一致）；非常规情形下交易所经与FINMA协商可另行发布卖空限制规定
cells.en: Short selling is permitted without a pre-borrow requirement; the seller must be able to settle the short sale by the time of trade execution; in special situations the Exchange may, after consultation with FINMA, issue additional short-selling restrictions

cells.zh: 做市商须与交易所签订书面「Market Maker Agreement」；具体按细分市场设定报价覆盖率与最大点差要求，如蓝筹股要求月均80%以上交易时段内维持不超过2.5%（或部分品种5%）的最大点差
cells.en: Market makers must sign a written "Market Maker Agreement" with the Exchange; coverage and maximum-spread requirements vary by segment, e.g. Blue Chip Shares require quoting over 80% of trading hours (monthly average) with a maximum spread of 2.5% (or 5% for certain instruments)

cells.zh: 披露为本：Regulatory Board依提交文件审核上市申请是否满足《上市规则》要求，符合即予批准（可附加条件），上市本身不构成对证券或发行人的价值判断；无需FINMA另行批准
cells.en: Disclosure-based: the Regulatory Board reviews listing applications against the requirements of the Listing Rules and approves (possibly with conditions) if met; listing itself is not a value judgment on the securities or issuer. No additional FINMA approval required

cells.zh: 五类情形：(1)发行人依合理申请主动退市；(2)偿付能力存在重大疑虑或已进入破产/清算程序；(3)Regulatory Board认定证券市场流动性已不足；(4)连续停牌三个月且暂停原因持续存在；(5)不再满足上市要求
cells.en: Five categories: (1) a justified application by the issuer; (2) serious doubt over solvency, or insolvency/liquidation proceedings already commenced; (3) the Regulatory Board deeming the market no longer sufficiently liquid; (4) trading suspended continuously for three months with the reasons persisting; (5) listing requirements no longer fulfilled

cells.zh: T+2（成交后第二个交易日）
cells.en: T+2 (the second exchange day following execution)

cells.zh: SIX x-clear AG
cells.en: SIX x-clear AG

cells.zh: SIX SIS AG
cells.en: SIX SIS AG

cells.zh: 不适用（本所记录的是现货证券市场；衍生品合约的交割方式在本所体系外，属另行运营的相关衍生品市场）
cells.en: N/A (this record covers the cash securities market; derivatives delivery mechanics fall outside this entity)

cells.zh: SIX对所有场内交易收取费用，按「每笔交易 × 每参与者」计提，取决于该参与者的总交易额（从价费，ad valorem fee）与交易笔数；另有按月容量费（依所选接口与吞吐量）。具体费率见《List of Charges under Trading Rules》（LOC-TR）。
cells.en: SIX charges a fee for all on-Exchange transactions, calculated per transaction and per participant, depending on the participant's total trading turnover (money involved; ad valorem fee) and number of transactions; a monthly capacity fee also applies by interface and throughput. Specific rates are in the List of Charges under Trading Rules (LOC-TR).

cells.zh: 联邦证券交易印花税（Umsatzabgabe/transfer stamp tax）：本国证券1.5‰（合0.15%），外国证券3.0‰（合0.3%）——按证券买卖对价计算，由境内证券商作为交易方或中介参与时征收，实务上买卖双方各承担一半
cells.en: Federal securities transfer stamp tax (Umsatzabgabe): 1.5‰ (0.15%) for securities issued by a Swiss tax resident, 3.0‰ (0.3%) for securities issued by a foreign tax resident — calculated on the consideration paid, levied where a Swiss securities dealer participates as a contracting party or intermediary; in practice split between buyer and seller

cells.zh: 会员制
cells.en: Member-owned

cells.zh: 否
cells.en: No

cells.zh: 人民币（A股）；美元（B股，规模很小且趋于边缘化）
cells.en: RMB (A-shares); USD (B-shares, very small and increasingly marginal in scale)

cells.zh: 人民币（B股为美元）
cells.en: RMB (USD for B-shares)

cells.zh: 中国证券监督管理委员会
cells.en: China Securities Regulatory Commission (CSRC)

cells.zh: 中国证券业协会（券商层面）；交易所自身对上市公司行使一线自律监管职能
cells.en: Securities Association of China (SAC)

cells.zh: 《中华人民共和国证券法》
cells.en: Securities Law of the People's Republic of China
Opening Call Auction (9:15-9:25)

cells.zh: 收盘集合竞价（14:57-15:00，普通证券适用；基金交易无独立收盘集合竞价）
cells.en: Closing Call Auction (14:57-15:00)

cells.zh: 订单驱动：证券竞价交易按价格优先、时间优先的原则在中央订单簿撮合，无做市商介入；仅科创板股票交易可实行做市商机制，由做市商提供双边报价服务
cells.en: Order-driven: auction trading is matched in the central order book on price-then-time priority with no dealer intervention; only STAR Market stocks may operate a market-making mechanism under which market makers provide two-sided quotes

cells.zh: 价格优先、时间优先
cells.en: Price priority and time priority

cells.zh: 限价申报；市价申报（仅限连续竞价阶段，另细分为多种执行方式）
cells.en: Limit orders; market orders (continuous auction only, further divided into several execution modes)

cells.zh: 百分比涨跌幅
cells.en: Percentage price-limit band

cells.zh: 无指数级熔断（2016年1月8日起暂停实施）
cells.en: No index-level circuit breaker (suspended since 8 January 2016)

cells.zh: 科创板设「异常波动」与「严重异常波动」两级指标并公告，不中断交易；无涨跌幅限制股票另有盘中30%/60%触发的10分钟临时停牌
cells.en: STAR Market has two tiers of public disclosure triggers — "abnormal fluctuation" and "severe abnormal fluctuation" — that do not interrupt trading; stocks without a price-limit band separately have a 10-minute intraday trading halt triggered at 30%/60% price moves

cells.zh: 无涨跌幅限制的股票盘中较开盘价首次涨跌达30%或60%，实施单次10分钟临时停牌；另有因违规嫌疑的特别停牌
cells.en: For stocks without a price-limit band, a single 10-minute intraday trading halt is triggered the first time the intraday price rises or falls 30% or 60% from that day's opening price; a separate special halt applies where rule violations are suspected

cells.zh: T+1（股票整体）；部分品种（跨境/商品/货币/黄金ETF、权证等）实行 T+0
cells.en: T+1 for stocks overall; certain products (cross-border/commodity/currency/gold ETFs, warrants, etc.) trade T+0

cells.zh: 融资融券制度，限指定标的范围内进行
cells.en: Margin Trading and Short Selling

cells.zh: 科创板股票交易可实行做市商机制，做市商可提供双边报价
cells.en: Market Making Mechanism

cells.zh: 注册制（主板与科创板均已实行注册制）
cells.en: Registration-based system (both the Main Board and the STAR Market now operate under the registration-based system)

cells.zh: 四类强制退市（交易类、财务类、规范类、重大违法类）+ 主动退市
cells.en: Four categories of mandatory delisting (trading-based, financial, compliance, major-violation) plus voluntary delisting

cells.zh: 中国证券登记结算有限责任公司
cells.en: China Securities Depository and Clearing Corporation Limited (ChinaClear)

cells.zh: 中国证券登记结算有限责任公司（与 CCP 为同一机构）
cells.en: ChinaClear

cells.zh: 不适用（现货市场，无实物/现金交割概念）
cells.en: Not applicable (a cash market; no physical/cash delivery concept)

cells.zh: 交易经手费等，由交易参与人向交易所缴纳
cells.en: Trading handling fees, etc., paid by trading participants to the Exchange

cells.zh: 0.05%（单边，卖方缴纳）：证券交易印花税自 2023 年 8 月 28 日起由单边 1‰ 减半至 0.5‰。征收方向为卖方——《中华人民共和国印花税法》（2021 通过、2022-07-01 施行）第三条明文『证券交易印花税对证券交易的出让方征收，不对受让方征收』。印花税为全国统一税率的国家税种、非交易所自定，上交所与深交所适用同一税率。
cells.en: 0.05% (one-sided, paid by the seller): the securities transaction stamp duty was halved from 1‰ to 0.5‰ per side from 28 August 2023. The seller side is confirmed by Article 3 of the PRC Stamp Tax Law (passed 2021, effective 1 July 2022): 'the securities transaction stamp duty is levied on the transferor of a securities transaction, not on the transferee'. Stamp duty is a nationally uniform state tax set centrally, not by the exchange, and SSE and SZSE apply the same rate.

cells.zh: 会员制
cells.en: Member-owned, Self-regulated Legal Entity

cells.zh: 否
cells.en: No

cells.zh: 人民币（A股）；港元（B股，规模很小且趋于边缘化）
cells.en: RMB (A-shares); HKD (B-shares, small and marginal)

cells.zh: 人民币（B股为港元）
cells.en: RMB (HKD for B-shares)

cells.zh: 中国证券监督管理委员会
cells.en: China Securities Regulatory Commission (CSRC)

cells.zh: 中国证券业协会（券商层面）；深交所自身对上市公司与会员行使一线自律监管职能
cells.en: Securities Association of China (SAC); SZSE itself as front-line self-regulator

cells.zh: 《中华人民共和国证券法》
cells.en: Securities Law of the People's Republic of China
Opening Call Auction (9:15-9:25)
Closing Call Auction (14:57-15:00)

cells.zh: 订单驱动：证券竞价交易按价格优先、时间优先在中央订单簿撮合，无做市商介入；仅创业板股票交易可实行做市商机制，做市商承担双边持续报价、双边回应报价等义务
cells.en: Order-driven: auction trading is matched in the central order book on price-then-time priority with no dealer intervention; only ChiNext stocks may operate a market-making mechanism under which market makers must provide continuous and responsive two-sided quotes

cells.zh: 价格优先、时间优先
cells.en: Price priority and time priority

cells.zh: 限价申报；市价申报（六种类型，仅限有价格涨跌幅限制证券的连续竞价阶段）
cells.en: Limit Order; Market Order (six sub-types, continuous auction only, price-limited securities)

cells.zh: 百分比涨跌幅
cells.en: Percentage price band

cells.zh: 无指数级熔断（2016年1月8日起暂停实施）
cells.en: No index-level circuit breaker (suspended since 8 January 2016)

cells.zh: 主板/创业板股票、封闭式基金设「异常波动」与「严重异常波动」两级指标并公告交易信息，不中断交易
cells.en: Two-tier 'abnormal fluctuation' / 'severe abnormal fluctuation' indicators for Main Board / ChiNext stocks and closed-end funds, triggering disclosure but not a trading halt

cells.zh: 无涨跌幅限制的股票盘中较开盘价首次涨跌达30%或60%，实施单次10分钟临时停牌；跨越14:57的临时停牌于14:57复牌并进行复牌集合竞价
cells.en: For a stock with no price limit, a first intraday move of 30% or 60% from the day's open price triggers a single 10-minute trading halt; if the halt window crosses 2:57 p.m., trading resumes at 2:57 p.m. with a resumption call auction

cells.zh: T+1（股票整体）；部分品种（债券ETF/货币基金/黄金ETF/跨境ETF与LOF/商品期货ETF）实行 T+0；B股次一交易日起回转
cells.en: T+1 (equities); T+0 for designated fund types; T+1 (from next trading day) for B-shares

cells.zh: 融资融券制度，限指定标的范围；卖空申报价格遵循「报升规则」，不得低于最近成交价（个别本所认可品种除外）
cells.en: Margin Trading and Securities Lending; short-sell orders subject to an uptick (tick) rule

cells.zh: 创业板股票交易可实行做市商机制，做市商提供双边持续报价、双边回应报价
cells.en: Market Making Mechanism (ChiNext)

cells.zh: 注册制（主板与创业板均已实行注册制）
cells.en: Registration-based

cells.zh: 四类强制退市（交易类、财务类、规范类、重大违法类）+ 主动退市；主板「面值退市」标准为连续二十个交易日收盘价均低于1元，市值退市标准为连续二十个交易日收盘总市值均低于5亿元，股东人数标准为连续二十个交易日股东人数均少于2000人；创业板市值退市标准更低（3亿元），股东人数退市标准也更低（400人）
cells.en: Four categories of mandatory delisting (trading-based, financial, compliance, major violation) plus voluntary delisting; ChiNext applies lower market-cap and shareholder-count thresholds than the Main Board

cells.zh: 中国证券登记结算有限责任公司
cells.en: China Securities Depository and Clearing Corporation Limited (ChinaClear)

cells.zh: 中国证券登记结算有限责任公司（与 CCP 为同一机构）
cells.en: ChinaClear

cells.zh: 不适用（现货市场，无实物/现金交割概念）
cells.en: Not applicable (a cash equity market, with no physical/cash delivery concept)

cells.zh: A股、B股交易经手费按成交金额 0.0341‰ 双边收取（2023年8月28日起下调；此前为0.0487‰）；大宗交易按下调后费率再下浮（A股30%、B股50%）；另有会员管理费用
cells.en: Transaction handling fee: 0.0341‰ of trade value, bilateral (reduced from 0.0487‰ effective 28 August 2023)

cells.zh: 0.05%（单边，卖方缴纳）：证券交易印花税自 2023 年 8 月 28 日起由单边 1‰ 减半至 0.5‰。征收方向为卖方——《中华人民共和国印花税法》（2021 通过、2022-07-01 施行）第三条明文『证券交易印花税对证券交易的出让方征收，不对受让方征收』。印花税为全国统一税率的国家税种、非交易所自定，深交所与上交所适用同一税率。
cells.en: 0.05% (one-sided, paid by the seller): the securities transaction stamp duty was halved from 1‰ to 0.5‰ per side from 28 August 2023. The seller side is confirmed by Article 3 of the PRC Stamp Tax Law (passed 2021, effective 1 July 2022): 'the securities transaction stamp duty is levied on the transferor of a securities transaction, not on the transferee'. Stamp duty is a nationally uniform state tax set centrally, not by the exchange, and SZSE and SSE apply the same rate.

cells.zh: 公司制但未单独上市——Eurex Deutschland本身不是被交易的上市实体，母集团Deutsche Börse Group本身是上市公司，但那是另一层
cells.en: Corporate but not separately listed — Eurex Deutschland itself is not a listed trading entity; parent Deutsche Börse Group is publicly listed, but that is a separate corporate layer

cells.zh: 否，Eurex Deutschland自身未上市
cells.en: No, Eurex Deutschland itself is not listed

cells.zh: 多币种——按标的合约计价，欧元为主，另有美元、英镑、瑞士法郎等计价的产品
cells.en: Multi-currency — denominated per underlying contract; primarily EUR, with USD/GBP/CHF-denominated products also listed

cells.zh: 同交易货币，按合约计价货币结算
cells.en: Same as trading currency; settled in the currency each contract is denominated in

cells.zh: 黑森州最高监管机关（交易所监管机关，Exchange Supervisory Authority）——不是联邦金融监管局BaFin
cells.en: The competent highest state authority in the State of Hesse ("Exchange Supervisory Authority") — not the federal BaFin

cells.zh: 交易所理事会（Exchange Council），依据德国交易所法及黑森州交易所条例设立
cells.en: Exchange Council, established pursuant to the German Stock Exchange Act and the Exchange Regulation issued by the State of Hesse

cells.zh: 《德国交易所法》（Börsengesetz）
cells.en: German Stock Exchange Act (Börsengesetz)

cells.zh: 开盘集合竞价（Opening Auction），期间可继续提交订单/报价，以撮合成交量最大的价格定开盘价（Netting流程）
cells.en: Opening Auction; additional Orders and Quotes may still be entered during the auction, with the opening price determined via a netting process maximizing matched volume

cells.zh: 收盘集合竞价（Closing Auction），部分品种另设盘中收盘集合竞价（intra-day Closing Auction）
cells.en: Closing Auction; some instruments also have intra-day Closing Auctions

cells.zh: 混合模式：Eurex T7 为中央电子订单簿、连续撮合；叠加受监管做市商制度——做市商须申请资格，在至少一个衍生品上按月平均覆盖每日交易时段 50% 的时间持续提供有约束力的双边报价，期权市场流动性尤其依赖做市商
cells.en: Hybrid: Eurex T7 is a central electronic order book with continuous matching, complemented by a Regulated Market Maker regime — market makers must be admitted and continuously enter binding two-way quotes in at least one Derivative covering 50% of daily Trading Hours on a monthly average; options liquidity in particular relies on market makers

cells.zh: 市价申报优先于限价申报执行；具体价格/时间优先顺序细则详见交易系统规则
cells.en: Market Orders are always executed before Limit Orders; detailed price/time priority mechanics are set out in the trading system rules

cells.zh: 市价申报、限价申报、止损申报（Market/Limit/Stop Orders）、冰山申报（Iceberg Orders）；另支持多种复合工具（跨期价差组合等策略）
cells.en: Market Orders, Limit Orders, Stop Orders, and Iceberg Orders; complex instruments (e.g. calendar spread strategies) are also supported

cells.zh: 动态/静态价格区间（Dynamic/Static Price Range），预期成交价超出区间即触发波动性中断，而非直接禁止申报的固定涨跌停
cells.en: Dynamic/static price ranges; when the next expected execution price falls outside the range, a Volatility Interruption is triggered rather than the order being flatly rejected as with a fixed daily limit

cells.zh: 区间宽度与参考价由管理董事会（Management Board）按每个衍生品逐一确定，未公开统一的百分比表（与JPX值幅制限、美股LULD的Tier分级不同，本所未见公开的统一档位表）
cells.en: The size of each price range and its reference prices are set by the Management Board per Derivative; no single published percentage table was found (unlike JPX's tiered yen bands or the U.S. LULD Tier system)

cells.zh: 无独立于波动性中断之外的全市场级熔断；波动性中断（见volatility_interruption）触发后管理董事会可扩大到同一衍生品的全部合约暂停交易，但本次未找到覆盖全市场所有产品的熔断安排
cells.en: No market-wide circuit breaker separate from the Volatility Interruption mechanism; upon a Volatility Interruption the Management Board may extend the trading halt to all Instruments of the same Derivative, but no exchange-wide halt covering all products was found in the content fetched this session

cells.zh: 波动性中断（Volatility Interruption）：预期成交价超出动态或静态价格区间即触发，中断后以集合竞价方式恢复交易（紧接的收盘集合竞价除外）
cells.en: Volatility Interruption: triggered when the next expected execution price falls outside the dynamic or static price range; trading resumes via an auction (unless immediately followed by a Closing Auction)

cells.zh: 见 volatility_interruption；另有因技术故障或第25条（德国交易所法）等原因的停牌未逐条核实
cells.en: See volatility_interruption; halts due to technical failures or under Section 25 of the German Stock Exchange Act also exist but were not individually verified

cells.zh: 受监管做市商制度（Regulated Market Maker）：需申请获得资格，须在至少一个衍生品品种上按月平均覆盖每日交易时段50%的时间持续提供双边报价，具体点差/报价量要求由管理董事会另行规定
cells.en: Regulated Market Maker system: admission required; must continuously enter binding two-way quotes in at least one Derivative covering 50% of daily Trading Hours on a monthly average, with specific spread/volume requirements set separately by the Management Board

cells.zh: 欧洲期货结算公司
cells.en: Eurex Clearing AG

cells.zh: 视产品而定：实物交割为默认方式（如部分利率/债券期货），管理董事会可决定排除实物交割改为现金结算
cells.en: Depends on the product: physical delivery is the default for some products (e.g. certain interest-rate/bond futures); the Management Board may rule out physical delivery in favor of cash settlement

cells.zh: 按三类收费：交易参与准入费、交易参与年费（由管理董事会确定）、交易员资格考试费；另有成交撤销/更正申请费每笔500欧元
cells.en: Three fee categories: admission fee, annual participation fee (set by the Management Board), and Exchange Trader examination fee; a separate EUR 500 fee applies per cancellation/correction application

cells.zh: Eurex 衍生品交易不征印花税/证券转移税：其一，衍生品合约本身不发生证券过户，没有可课印花税的转让行为；其二，德国唯一的证券流转税「证券交易税」(Börsenumsatzsteuer) 已于 1991 年 1 月 1 日依《改善金融市场条件法》(Gesetz zur Verbesserung der Rahmenbedingungen der Finanzmärkte) 第 4 条废除（与 de-xetra 的 stamp_duty 字段同一 Bundestag 来源，本字段自持一份）。
cells.en: Eurex derivatives trading incurs no stamp duty / securities transfer tax: first, a derivative contract itself effects no transfer of securities and so there is no transaction to stamp; second, Germany's only securities turnover tax, the Börsenumsatzsteuer, was abolished with effect from 1 January 1991 under Article 4 of the Act to Improve the Framework Conditions for Financial Markets (same Bundestag source as de-xetra's stamp_duty field, held here in this field's own right).

cells.zh: 公法机构（具有有限法律行为能力的公法机构，本身不能作为私法主体），由Deutsche Börse AG作为运营公司（Trägerin）负责人员/资金/场地等运营事项——不属于enums.yml现有四个组织形式词条（公司制上市/公司制未上市/会员制/国有事业单位制）中的任何一个，是本项目首次遇到的第五种模式，见文件顶部说明与OPEN-QUESTIONS
cells.en: Public-law institution with limited legal capacity (cannot itself be a private-law legal entity); Deutsche Börse AG acts as the operating company ("Trägerin") providing staff, funds and premises — does not cleanly fit any of the four existing organization_form enum values (demutualized listed/unlisted, member-owned, state-owned); this is the project's first encounter with this fifth pattern, see file header and OPEN-QUESTIONS

cells.zh: 否——FWB本身是公法机构，依官方原文的表述根本不能作为私法主体存在，因而不存在「FWB自身股份」这个概念；其运营公司Deutsche Börse AG是一家独立上市公司，但那是另一层法律实体，与de-eurex的情况相同
cells.en: No — FWB itself is a public-law institution and, per the official text, cannot exist as a private-law entity, so there is no concept of "FWB's own shares"; its operating company Deutsche Börse AG is a separately listed company, a distinct legal layer, same structure as de-eurex

cells.zh: 以欧元为主；管理董事会可为个别证券另行指定交易货币与结算货币，允许多币种交易/结算
cells.en: Primarily EUR; the Management Board may designate a different trading and settlement currency for individual Securities, allowing multi-currency trading/settlement

cells.zh: 原则上同交易货币（以欧元为主），个别证券可另设结算货币，规则依据同trading_currency
cells.en: In principle the same as the trading currency (primarily EUR); individual Securities may have a different settlement currency, same rule basis as trading_currency

cells.zh: 黑森州最高联邦州级主管机关（交易所监管机关，Exchange Supervisory Authority）——与de-eurex记录的机关同一层级，不是联邦金融监管局BaFin；但BaFin在证券发行披露/持续披露/卖空监管等业务行为层面另有联邦级监管职能，见disclosure_requirements与continuing_obligations字段
cells.en: Highest competent federal state authority of the State of Hesse ("Exchange Supervisory Authority") — same level as recorded for de-eurex, not the federal BaFin; BaFin separately holds federal-level supervisory functions over disclosure/short-selling matters, see disclosure_requirements and continuing_obligations fields

cells.zh: 交易所理事会（Exchange Council / Börsenrat）：负责发布交易所规则、交易条件、费用规则、交易员准入规则，并在与交易所监管机关协商后任免管理董事会成员
cells.en: Exchange Council (Börsenrat): responsible for issuing the Exchange Rules, Conditions for Transactions, Fee Regulations and admission rules for Exchange Traders, and appoints/dismisses Managing Directors in agreement with the Exchange Supervisory Authority

cells.zh: 《德国交易所法》（Börsengesetz）
cells.en: German Stock Exchange Act (Börsengesetz)

cells.zh: 开盘集合竞价（Opening Auction），集中流动性并综合尽可能多的订单确定开盘价
cells.en: Opening Auction; concentrates liquidity and determines the opening price by taking into account as many orders as possible

cells.zh: 收盘集合竞价（Closing Auction）确定收盘价；DAX/MDAX/SDAX成分股另设收盘后最长5分钟的Trade-at-Close定点交易
cells.en: Closing Auction determines the closing price; DAX/MDAX/SDAX constituents additionally have a Trade-at-Close period of up to 5 minutes after the closing auction

cells.zh: 混合模式：Xetra 为中央电子限价订单簿、价格-时间优先连续撮合；对流动性较低的证券叠加指定发起人（Designated Sponsor）制度——由做市参与者持续提供有约束力的双边报价，须守最大点差、最小报价量、最小报价时长等质量标准
cells.en: Hybrid: Xetra is a central electronic limit order book matching on price-time priority; for less liquid securities it adds the Designated Sponsor scheme — market participants providing binding two-way quotes subject to quality criteria (maximum spread, minimum quote volume, minimum quotation duration)

cells.zh: 价格优先、时间优先原则（Price-Time Priority）：无法按determined价格全部成交的限价订单按申报先后顺序执行；不限价订单（市价订单）优先执行
cells.en: Price-Time Priority: Limit Orders that cannot be fully executed at the determined price are executed in chronological order of entry; Unlimited (Market) Orders are executed preferentially

cells.zh: 市价订单（Market Orders，不限价）、限价订单（Limit Orders）、冰山订单（Iceberg Orders）、止损订单（Stop Limit/Stop Market Orders）、一撤二组合订单（One-Cancels-Other Orders）、跟踪止损订单（Trailing Stop Orders）等
cells.en: Market Orders (unlimited), Limit Orders, Iceberg Orders, Stop Orders (Stop Limit/Stop Market), One-Cancels-Other Orders, Trailing Stop Orders, among others

cells.zh: 动态/静态价格区间（Dynamic/Static Price Range）：预期成交价超出区间触发波动性中断，而非直接拒绝申报的固定涨跌停——与同集团de-eurex机制高度一致（同一套集团级模板）
cells.en: Dynamic/static price ranges: a Volatility Interruption is triggered when the potential next execution price falls outside the range, rather than the order being flatly rejected as with a fixed daily limit — closely mirrors de-eurex's mechanism (shared group-level template)

cells.zh: 区间宽度与参考价由管理董事会按每只证券分别确定，本次未在抓取材料中找到公开的统一百分比档位表
cells.en: The size of each price range and its reference prices are set by the Management Board per Security; no single published percentage table was found in the materials fetched this session

cells.zh: 无独立于波动性中断之外的全市场级熔断；管理董事会另有一般性停牌裁量权（因突发事件或维护公共利益需要），但本次未找到基于大盘指数跌幅触发的全市场熔断机制，与de-eurex/jp-jpx情况相似
cells.en: No market-wide circuit breaker separate from the Volatility Interruption mechanism; the Management Board separately holds general discretionary power to suspend trading (in emergencies or to protect the public interest), but no index-decline-triggered market-wide circuit breaker was found in the materials fetched this session — similar to de-eurex/jp-jpx

cells.zh: 波动性中断（Volatility Interruption）：预期成交价超出动态/静态价格区间即触发，切换为集合竞价方式恢复交易；分「单一波动性中断」与「自动扩展区间波动性中断」两种模型（后者用于ETF/ETN/ETC），与de-eurex的机制高度相似（同集团模板）
cells.en: Volatility Interruption: triggered when the potential next execution price falls outside the dynamic/static price range, switching the trading form to an auction; two models — Single Volatility Interruption and Volatility Interruption with automated price range extension (the latter for ETFs/ETNs/ETCs) — closely mirroring de-eurex's mechanism (shared group template)

cells.zh: 管理董事会可因突发事件暂停交易（suspension，已存订单被删除）或永久停止交易（discontinuation）；暂停/停止措施须立即通知交易所监管机关与联邦金融监管局BaFin
cells.en: The Management Board may suspend trading in an emergency (existing orders are deleted) or permanently discontinue trading; such measures must be immediately reported to the Exchange Supervisory Authority and the federal regulator BaFin

cells.zh: 交易层面为 T+0（当日买入的证券当日即可卖出）——FWB Exchange Rules（Börsenordnung）与 Xetra 连续交易规则只规范订单 / 竞价 / 撮合，未设持有期或「交收前不得卖出」限制；结算层面按欧盟 CSDR 框架为 T+2（见 clearing.settlement_cycle，该字段本身因未抓到官方逐字表述留空）
cells.en: T+0 at the trading level (securities bought during the day may be sold the same day) — the FWB Exchange Rules (Börsenordnung) and the Xetra continuous-trading rules govern only orders, auctions and matching, with no holding-period or 'may not sell before settlement' restriction; settlement follows the EU CSDR T+2 framework (see clearing.settlement_cycle)

cells.zh: 普通股票卖空受欧盟《卖空规则》（Regulation (EU) No 236/2012）约束，需向BaFin申报净卖空头寸；FWB《交易所规则》§108另对结构性产品（证书/权证）发行商专设「备兑卖空」要求（发行时须已持有或已锁定足额证券）——与股票现货的卖空监管框架不是同一条规则
cells.en: General equity short selling is governed by the EU Short Selling Regulation (Regulation (EU) No 236/2012), with net short position notification to BaFin; the FWB Exchange Rules §108 separately imposes a covered-short requirement on issuers selling Structured Products (certificates/warrants) — a distinct rule from the general equity short-selling framework

cells.zh: 指定发起人制度（Designated Sponsor）：为流动性较低证券提供双边约束报价的做市参与者，须遵守最大点差、最小报价量、最小报价时长等质量标准；因其报价活动原则上亦受MiFID II/MiFIR监管做市商规则约束。另有「受监管做市商」（Regulated Market Maker）层级
cells.en: Designated Sponsor scheme: market participants posting binding two-way quotes for less liquid Securities, subject to quality criteria (maximum spread, minimum quote volume, minimum quotation duration); as quoting participants they are in principle also subject to the MiFID II/MiFIR Regulated Market Maker rules. A separate "Regulated Market Maker" tier also exists

cells.zh: 披露为本：招股说明书须经核准并公开发布（Prospectus/Inclusion Document经审批并发布）；Prime Standard的招股说明书审核与持续披露合规监管机构为联邦金融监管局BaFin
cells.en: Disclosure-based: a valid, approved and published Prospectus (or Inclusion Document for Scale) is required; compliance supervision (including for Prime Standard) rests with the federal regulator BaFin

cells.zh: 退市（撤销上市）须由发行人申请，或由管理董事会依《德国交易所法》第42条第2款依职权撤销（如发行人进入破产程序）
cells.en: Delisting (revocation of admission) is either by issuer application or ex officio by the Management Board pursuant to Section 42 Paragraph 2 of the German Stock Exchange Act (e.g. where insolvency proceedings have been opened against the issuer)

cells.zh: 欧洲期货结算公司（主中央对手方）；交易参与者可为特定证券指定Cboe Clear Europe N.V.为「优选中央对手方」，双方均选定同一优选对手方时按该方净额结算，否则默认由Eurex Clearing AG净额结算
cells.en: Eurex Clearing AG (primary CCP); trading participants may designate Cboe Clear Europe N.V. as their "Preferred CCP" for selected Securities — if both counterparties select the same preferred CCP the trade nets there, otherwise it defaults to Eurex Clearing AG

cells.zh: Clearstream Europe AG（或《交易所规则》认可的其他中央证券存管机构）
cells.en: Clearstream Europe AG (or another central securities depository recognized under the Exchange Rules)

cells.zh: 不适用（现货市场为主）——products章节所列品类（股票/ETF/ETP/证书权证/债券/基金）均为现货交收，非实物交割型衍生品
cells.en: N/A (predominantly a cash market) — the product categories listed in the products chapter (equities/ETFs/ETPs/certificates & warrants/bonds/funds) are cash-market instruments, not physically-delivered derivatives

cells.zh: 按类别收费：参与者一次性准入费、年度参与费（依《费用规则》表I/II）；连续竞价中撤销成交（Mistrade申请）每笔另收500欧元费用，结构性产品的多笔关联Mistrade申请可另计
cells.en: Fees by category: a one-time participant admission fee, an annual participation fee (per Fee Regulations Tables I/II); a separate EUR 500 fee applies per Mistrade Application (transaction-cancellation request) in Continuous Auction trading, with additional tiered fees for related Mistrade Applications on Structured Products

cells.zh: 德国不对证券买卖征收印花税/证券转移税；历史上的「证券交易税」（Börsenumsatzsteuer）已于1991年1月1日废除（依据《改善金融市场条件法》第4条），不同于英国的外国股票SDRT
cells.en: Germany levies no stamp duty / securities transfer tax on securities trades; the historical Börsenumsatzsteuer (stock exchange sales tax) was abolished with effect from 1 January 1991 (under Article 4 of the Act to Improve the Framework Conditions for Financial Markets), unlike the UK's SDRT on foreign shares

cells.zh: 公司制且自身上市——Euronext N.V.是2014年由ICE分拆重新独立IPO的上市公司，本身即在旗下Euronext Paris挂牌
cells.en: Corporate and self-listed — Euronext N.V. is the independently re-IPO'd public company spun off from ICE in 2014, and is itself listed on its own Euronext Paris market

cells.zh: 是——Euronext N.V.本身在Euronext Paris挂牌交易，交易代码ENX，2025年9月起纳入法国CAC 40指数成分
cells.en: Yes — Euronext N.V. itself trades on Euronext Paris under ticker ENX, and was added to the French CAC 40 index constituents from September 2025

cells.zh: 多币种，按各市场本国货币计价为主：阿姆斯特丹/布鲁塞尔/都柏林/里斯本/巴黎（欧元区五国）以欧元计价，米兰以欧元计价，奥斯陆以挪威克朗（NOK）计价——是本所与欧元区单一货币交易所最直接的结构性差异；部分产品另有美元/英镑等计价，未逐一核实
cells.en: Multi-currency, predominantly each market's home currency: Amsterdam/Brussels/Dublin/Lisbon/Paris/Milan (all euro-area) price in EUR; Oslo prices in Norwegian Krone (NOK) — the most direct structural contrast with a single-currency exchange; some products are denominated in USD/GBP etc., not individually verified

cells.zh: 原则上与交易货币一致，按各市场本国货币结算；具体是否存在跨市场结算货币统一安排（如是否可用单一欧元账户结算奥斯陆NOK计价证券）本次未核实
cells.en: In principle matches the trading currency, settled in each market's home currency; whether a unified cross-market settlement currency arrangement exists (e.g. settling Oslo NOK-denominated securities via a single EUR account) was not verified this session

cells.zh: 无单一监管机构——七个市场运营实体分别受本国证券监管机构监管、适用本国法律：Euronext Amsterdam（荷兰，AFM/DNB）、Euronext Brussels（比利时，FSMA/BNB）、Euronext Paris（法国，AMF）、Euronext Dublin（爱尔兰，Central Bank of Ireland）、Euronext Lisbon（葡萄牙，CMVM）、Borsa Italiana（意大利，CONSOB）、Oslo Børs（挪威，Finanstilsynet）；六国监管机构就跨市场监管事项建立协调机制。这是本所与此前所有单一法域交易所样本最根本的结构差异
cells.en: No single regulator — each of the seven Market Undertakings is supervised by, and governed under the law of, its own jurisdiction: Euronext Amsterdam (Netherlands, AFM/DNB), Euronext Brussels (Belgium, FSMA/BNB), Euronext Paris (France, AMF), Euronext Dublin (Ireland, Central Bank of Ireland), Euronext Lisbon (Portugal, CMVM), Borsa Italiana (Italy, CONSOB), Oslo Børs (Norway, Finanstilsynet); regulators in six countries have established a coordination mechanism for cross-market supervisory matters. This is the most fundamental structural difference from every single-jurisdiction exchange sampled so far in this project

cells.zh: 无单一核心法律——七个市场运营实体各自适用本国转化MiFID II（欧盟金融工具市场指令）后的国内法：荷兰《金融监督法》（Wet op het financieel toezicht）第5:26条、比利时2017年11月21日《金融工具市场基础设施法》、法国《货币与金融法典》第L.421-2条、葡萄牙2007年357-C号法令等；MiFID II/MiFIR是各国国内法背后共同的欧盟层级立法基础
cells.en: No single core law — each of the seven Market Undertakings operates under its own country's national implementation of MiFID II (the EU Markets in Financial Instruments Directive): the Netherlands' Financial Supervision Act (Wet op het financieel toezicht) Article 5:26, Belgium's Law of 21 November 2017 on market infrastructures, France's Monetary and Financial Code Article L.421-2, Portugal's Decree-Law 357-C/2007, etc.; MiFID II/MiFIR is the shared EU-level legislative basis behind each national law

cells.zh: 开盘集合竞价（Opening uncrossing）：订单累积期内只录入订单不成交，撮合算法启动时中央订单簿短暂冻结，以能实现最大成交量的理论开盘价定价；若无法撮合，则以主交易时段第一笔成交价作为开盘价
cells.en: Opening uncrossing: during the order-accumulation period orders are entered but not matched; when the matching algorithm runs the Central Order Book is briefly frozen and the opening price is set at the level that maximises matched volume; if no match occurs, the price of the first trade in the main trading session becomes the opening price

cells.zh: 收盘集合竞价（Closing uncrossing）：机制与开盘集合竞价相同；收盘参考价通常即收盘集合竞价成交价，若集合竞价未产生成交价则退而采用主交易时段最后成交价
cells.en: Closing uncrossing: the same mechanism as the opening uncrossing; the closing reference price is generally the closing-uncrossing price, falling back to the last traded price of the main session if the uncrossing produces no price

cells.zh: 混合模式：Optiq 为中央电子限价订单簿，严格价格优先、时间优先连续撮合；同时设多类流动性提供者制度——面向 ETF 的做市商计划、面向结构性产品的做市商义务，以及零售流动性厂商（其报价仅能与零售订单撮合、享同价位优先权）
cells.en: Hybrid: Optiq is a central electronic limit order book matching on strict price-then-time priority, running alongside several liquidity-provider schemes — ETF market-maker programmes, Structured Product market-maker obligations, and Retail Liquidity Firms whose quotes match only Retail Orders and are given same-price precedence

cells.zh: 严格价格优先，同价位按时间优先（strict price/time priority）；对未公开披露的订单类型（大宗订单Large-in-Scale、中间价订单Mid-Point）另有独立的规模/时间优先规则
cells.en: Strict price priority, with strict time priority at the same price level; orders exempted from pre-trade transparency (Large-in-Scale orders, Mid-Point orders) follow separate size/time priority rules

cells.zh: 市价单（Market）、限价单（Limit）、止损单（Stop）、冰山单（Iceberg）、中间价单（Mid-Point/Primary Peg）、最小成交量单、仅参与集合竞价的VFU/VFCU订单、拍卖量发现单（Auction Volume Discovery, AVD）等，具体适用哪些类型按交易分组（trading group）而异
cells.en: Market, Limit, Stop, Iceberg, Mid-Point/Primary Peg, Minimum-quantity, auction-only VFU/VFCU orders, Auction Volume Discovery (AVD) orders, etc.; the specific set of order types available varies by trading group

cells.zh: 双层价格区间机制——动态区间（dynamic collar，基准价为逐笔更新的最新成交价）+ 静态区间（static collar，基准价为当日开盘价或前日收盘参考价），触及阈值即触发预约期（reservation period），不是直接拒单的固定百分比涨跌停
cells.en: Two-layer price-range mechanism — dynamic collars (reference price updated after each trade) plus static collars (reference price is the day's opening price or the previous day's closing reference price); breaching a threshold triggers a reservation period rather than flatly rejecting orders as with a fixed daily limit

cells.zh: 动态区间：普通股±5%，旗舰指数成分股±3%；静态区间：普通股±10%（对照前收盘价），旗舰指数成分股±8%——「旗舰指数」按fee guide定义为CAC 40/AEX/BEL 20/PSI/SBF 120/AMX/ISEQ 20/OBX/FTSE MIB成分股
cells.en: Dynamic collars: ±5% for ordinary shares, ±3% for flagship-index constituents; static collars: ±10% (vs previous close) for ordinary shares, ±8% for flagship-index constituents — "flagship index" per the fee guide covers constituents of CAC 40/AEX/BEL 20/PSI/SBF 120/AMX/ISEQ 20/OBX/FTSE MIB

cells.zh: 无独立于价格区间机制之外的全市场级熔断；动态/静态区间（见price_limits）本身是个股级机制，触发后进入预约期（reservation period），未见覆盖全市场所有品种的指数级熔断安排
cells.en: No market-wide circuit breaker separate from the price-collar mechanism; the dynamic/static collars (see price_limits) are themselves a stock-level mechanism that triggers a reservation period upon breach — no index-level, market-wide halt covering all instruments was found

cells.zh: 预约期（reservation period）：连续交易阶段理论撮合价触及适用阈值即触发预约期，至少持续3分钟；因动态区间触发的首次预约后，恢复交易有两种方式——由Euronext评估市场情况后人工设定参数，或按预约期内报价自动更新动态区间后自动撮合恢复；若自动方式仍在同方向再次触发预约，是否进一步调整区间/参考价须再经Euronext评估市场情况后决定
cells.en: Reservation period: triggered when the theoretical matching price during continuous trading breaches the applicable thresholds, lasting at least 3 minutes; upon the first reservation caused by a dynamic collar breach, resumption may follow either a manual process (parameters set by Euronext after assessing market conditions) or an automatic process with updated dynamic collars; if the automatic process is breached again in the same direction, any further adjustment to the collars or reference price is decided by Euronext only after a fresh market assessment

cells.zh: 见volatility_interruption；另有针对单一异常订单/异常事件的独立停牌能力，具体触发条件与恢复流程本次未逐条核实
cells.en: See volatility_interruption; a separate capacity to halt an instrument in response to a single disruptive order or unusual event also exists, exact trigger conditions and resumption process not individually verified this session

cells.zh: 交易层面为 T+0（当日买入的证券当日即可卖出）——Euronext Trading Manual 与 Rule Book Book I 只规范订单类型、竞价与撮合，未设持有期或「交收前不得卖出」限制；结算层面为 T+2（见 clearing.settlement_cycle；欧盟已定于 2027-10-11 统一改 T+1）
cells.en: T+0 at the trading level (securities bought during the day may be sold the same day) — the Euronext Trading Manual and Rule Book Book I govern only order types, auctions and matching, with no holding-period or "may not sell before settlement" restriction; settlement is T+2 (see clearing.settlement_cycle)

cells.zh: 存在多类流动性提供者安排（统称Liquidity Provider），含针对ETF的做市商计划、针对结构性产品的做市商义务，以及「零售流动性厂商」（Retail Liquidity Firm）——后者的报价仅能与零售订单撮合，享有同价位优先权；具体各计划的量化义务（点差、报价时长占比）本次未逐一核实
cells.en: Multiple categories of liquidity provider exist (collectively "Liquidity Providers"), including ETF market-maker programmes, Structured Product market-maker obligations, and "Retail Liquidity Firms" — whose quotes can only match Retail Orders and are given precedence at the same price level; the quantitative obligations of each programme (spread, quoting-time coverage) were not individually verified this session

cells.zh: T+2（欧盟现行统一结算周期）；欧盟已定于2027年10月11日统一改为T+1，Euronext已成立跨业务条线的T+1项目组配合过渡
cells.en: T+2 (the EU's current uniform settlement cycle); the EU has set a Union-wide move to T+1 for 11 October 2027, and Euronext has established a cross-business T+1 programme to support the transition

cells.zh: 欧洲期货清算所（商业名，法定实体为Cassa di Compensazione e Garanzia S.p.A.，意大利公司）
cells.en: Euronext Clearing (commercial name; the legal entity is Cassa di Compensazione e Garanzia S.p.A., an Italian company, formerly the CCP of Borsa Italiana known as CC&G)

cells.zh: 里斯本、米兰、奥斯陆三个市场已用集团自有的Euronext Securities托管结算；阿姆斯特丹（荷兰法人Euronext Amsterdam N.V.）目前使用Euroclear Nederland，布鲁塞尔（比利时法人）目前使用Euroclear Belgium，巴黎（法国法人）目前使用Euroclear France（官方规则手册逐字点名，见detail）——三者合称ESES（Euroclear Settlement of Euronext-zone Securities）平台，均计划自2026年9月21日起迁移至Euronext Securities Milan实体；都柏林（爱尔兰法人）自2021年3月起已由CREST（原Euroclear UK & Ireland运营）迁移至Euroclear Bank（国际中央证券存管机构，比利时法人），且都柏林不在2026年9月的迁移范围内（European Offering官方页面明确只覆盖阿姆斯特丹/布鲁塞尔/米兰/巴黎四个市场）
cells.en: Lisbon, Milan and Oslo are already settled/custodied via the Group's own Euronext Securities; Amsterdam (Dutch legal entity, Euronext Amsterdam N.V.) currently uses Euroclear Nederland, Brussels (Belgian legal entity) currently uses Euroclear Belgium, and Paris (French legal entity) currently uses Euroclear France (explicitly named in the official rulebook — see detail) — together known as the ESES (Euroclear Settlement of Euronext-zone Securities) platform, all three scheduled to migrate to the Euronext Securities Milan entity from 21 September 2026; Dublin (Irish legal entity) migrated from CREST (then operated by Euroclear UK & Ireland) to Euroclear Bank (an International CSD, a Belgian legal entity) in March 2021, and Dublin is confirmed NOT included in the September 2026 migration scope (the official European Offering page covers only Amsterdam, Brussels, Milan and Paris)

cells.zh: 现货市场为主，不适用衍生品式交割概念；集团旗下另有衍生品市场（见products章节）存在实物/现金交割安排，但本文件聚焦现货Securities Markets，衍生品市场交割方式本次未逐一核实
cells.en: Predominantly a cash-equity market — the physical/cash delivery concept does not apply; the Group's derivatives markets (see products chapter) do carry physical/cash delivery arrangements, but this file focuses on the Securities (cash) Markets and derivatives-market delivery terms were not individually verified this session

cells.zh: 标准股票交易费提供两种计价方式（会员逐月二选一）：方式一（默认）按已执行订单笔数阶梯收费（前70万笔€0.13/笔，其后每笔递减至最低€0.05）+ 按月成交金额阶梯收费（从0.95个基点递减至0.45个基点）；方式二为「最低承诺费+更低单笔/按值费率」的替代方案，区分蓝筹股（CAC 40/AEX/BEL 20/PSI/SBF 120/AMX/ISEQ 20/OBX/FTSE MIB成分股）与其他证券两档费率
cells.en: Standard equity trading fees offer two pricing options (member groups choose monthly): Option 1 (default) combines a tiered per-executed-order charge (€0.13/order for the first 700,000 orders, declining to €0.05) with a tiered monthly value-based charge (declining from 0.95bps to 0.45bps); Option 2 is an alternative "minimum commitment fee + lower per-order/value rate" structure, with separate rates for blue-chip constituents (CAC 40/AEX/BEL 20/PSI/SBF 120/AMX/ISEQ 20/OBX/FTSE MIB) versus other securities

cells.zh: 印花税属各国税法事项而非交易所规则；本所七个市场所属国中，法国自 2008 年起已废除股票交易印花税（但仍对部分衍生品/高频交易征收金融交易税，见 financial_transaction_tax），其余国家亦无针对普通股现货交易的经典「印花税」(stamp duty)。比利时/荷兰/爱尔兰/葡萄牙/挪威各有其他交易相关税种，但均非印花税性质。按 CLAUDE.md 第二节第四条，「常识性事实 + 单一来源」不足以支撑七国逐一「明确不征」，故 spec 记为 rate: null（幽灵条）而非 type: none，并转 OPEN-QUESTIONS。
cells.en: Stamp duty is a matter of each country's tax law rather than an exchange rule; among the seven markets' home countries, France abolished its stock-transaction stamp duty in 2008 (though it still levies a financial transaction tax on some derivatives / high-frequency trades, see financial_transaction_tax), and the other countries likewise have no classic "stamp duty" on ordinary cash-equity trading. Belgium, the Netherlands, Ireland, Portugal and Norway each have other transaction-related taxes, but none are stamp-duty in nature. Per the CLAUDE.md anti-hallucination rules, a general-knowledge fact plus a single source is not enough to assert "no stamp duty" for each of the seven countries, so the spec is recorded as rate: null (ghost bar) rather than type: none and referred to OPEN-QUESTIONS.

cells.zh: 公司制（自身上市）
cells.en: Demutualised, listed company (self-listed)

cells.zh: 是（股票代码 0388.HK，即在自己的主板上市）
cells.en: Yes (stock code 0388.HK, i.e. listed on its own Main Board)

cells.zh: 港元为主；2023年起推出双柜台模式，部分股票可另以人民币计价交易
cells.en: HKD; Dual Counter (HKD/RMB) since 2023

cells.zh: 港元（双柜台人民币柜台以人民币结算）
cells.en: Hong Kong dollars (the renminbi counter under the dual-counter model settles in renminbi)

cells.zh: 证券及期货事务监察委员会
cells.en: Securities and Futures Commission (SFC)

cells.zh: 港交所本身兼具前线监管职能（对上市公司与交易参与者）
cells.en: Front-line regulation by HKEX

cells.zh: 《证券及期货条例》
cells.en: Securities and Futures Ordinance (SFO)

cells.zh: 盘前集合竞价（9:00-9:30，单一价格）
cells.en: Pre-opening Session (POS)

cells.zh: 收盘集合竞价，4:00pm 起至 4:08-4:10pm 间随机收盘
cells.en: Closing Auction Session (CAS)

cells.zh: 订单驱动：证券市场交易平台 OTP-C 为中央电子订单簿，以严格的价格及时间优先次序连续配对；现货股票不设做市商。仅结构性产品（权证 / 牛熊证）、交易所买卖基金（ETF）及双柜台股票设有做市商制度
cells.en: Order-driven: the OTP-C central electronic order book matches continuously on strict price-then-time priority; cash equities have no market makers. Market-maker schemes exist only for structured products (warrants / CBBCs), ETFs and dual-counter securities

cells.zh: 现时 OTP-C（证券市场交易平台）以严格的价格及时间优先次序持续进行配对：较早时间输入系统的买卖盘必须完全执行，才可处理同等价格但较迟输入的买卖盘
cells.en: Under the current OTP-C (Orion Trading Platform – Securities Market), orders are continuously executed in strict price and time priority: an order entered into the system at an earlier time must be executed in full before an order at the same price entered at a later time is executed

cells.zh: 开市前时段及收市竞价时段只接受竞价盘及竞价限价盘；持续交易时段只接受限价盘、增强限价盘及特别限价盘，可选择附加「全数执行或立刻取消」指示
cells.en: The Pre-opening Session and the Closing Auction Session accept at-auction and at-auction limit orders only; the Continuous Trading Session accepts limit, enhanced limit and special limit orders only, with an optional "All-or-Nothing Qualifier"

cells.zh: 无涨跌幅限制（无 daily price limit）
cells.en: No daily price limit

cells.zh: 无每日涨跌停幅度（见 type / volatility_interruption）
cells.en: No daily price limit band (see type / volatility_interruption)

cells.zh: 无全市场熔断；个股/产品层级设波动性中断机制（官方中文全称：市場波動調節機制，简称市調機制）
cells.en: Volatility Control Mechanism (VCM)

cells.zh: 波动性中断机制（市調機制/VCM）：以5分钟前成交价为基准，触发阈值按恒生综合大型股/中型股/小型股指数成份股分组分别为±10%/±15%/±20%，触发后进入5分钟冷静期（非停牌，仅限价区间内可继续交易）
cells.en: Volatility Control Mechanism (VCM)

cells.zh: 无涨跌停亦无个股熔断停牌，VCM 触发后不停牌只限价（见上）；另有因披露事项的停牌机制未逐条核实
cells.en: No daily price limit and no stock-level circuit-breaker halt; when VCM is triggered trading continues within a price band rather than being halted (see above); a separate suspension mechanism triggered by disclosure matters exists but has not been verified in detail

cells.zh: T+0（可当日回转，无 SSE 式 T+1 限制）
cells.en: T+0 (same-day round-trip trading permitted; no SSE-style T+1 restriction)

cells.zh: 受监管的卖空：仅限「指定证券」、须为备兑卖空、遵守报升规则（不得低于最优卖盘价/参考价）
cells.en: Regulated Short Selling

cells.zh: 结构性产品（权证/牛熊证）、ETF、双柜台股票均设做市商制度，卖空规则中对做市商活动另有豁免安排
cells.en: Securities Market Maker / Dual Counter Market Maker

cells.zh: 披露为本制度（非注册制/核准制的简单二分，上市委员会对适合性有实质审核权）
cells.en: Disclosure-based regime (not a simple registration/merit-review dichotomy — the Listing Committee retains substantive discretion over suitability for listing)

cells.zh: 香港中央结算有限公司
cells.en: Hong Kong Securities Clearing Company Limited (HKSCC)

cells.zh: 香港中央结算有限公司（透过 CCASS 系统）
cells.en: CCASS (Central Clearing and Settlement System)

cells.zh: 不适用（现货市场为主）
cells.en: Not applicable (primarily a cash/spot market)

cells.zh: 港交所自身收取的「交易费」（Trading Fee）：每宗证券交易按代价金额单边0.00565%（四舍五入至分）向交易所缴付；对不同类别交易所买卖基金的证券市场做市商（SMM）交易另设不同宽免比率
cells.en: The Exchange's own "Trading Fee": 0.00565% per side of the consideration of a transaction (rounded to the nearest cent) is payable to the Exchange for each security transaction; different exemption rates apply to Securities Market Maker (SMM) transactions in different categories of Exchange Traded Products

cells.zh: 0.1%（买卖双方各自缴纳，2023年11月17日起由0.13%下调）
cells.en: 0.1% (payable by both the buyer and the seller separately; reduced from 0.13% effective 17 November 2023)

cells.zh: 印度卢比 (INR)
cells.en: INR

cells.zh: 印度卢比 (INR)
cells.en: INR

cells.zh: 印度证券交易委员会 (SEBI)
cells.en: Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI)

cells.zh: 未见独立于SEBI/交易所之外的第三方自律组织；一线监管职能由NSE自身'Regulation'条线（含会员合规、市场监察、信息披露监督等）承担
cells.en: No separate third-party SRO distinct from SEBI/the Exchange identified; front-line regulatory functions are carried out within NSE's own Regulation division (member compliance, market surveillance, disclosure oversight)

cells.zh: 《1956年证券合同（监管）法》(SCRA) 与《1992年印度证券交易委员会法》(SEBI Act)
cells.en: Securities Contracts (Regulation) Act, 1956 (SCRA); Securities and Exchange Board of India Act, 1992 (SEBI Act)

cells.zh: 开盘集合竞价（Pre-open session），09:00-09:08收集订单并撮合确定开盘价，此后09:15转入连续竞价；新股/复牌证券另有09:00-09:45的Special Pre-open session
cells.en: Opening call auction (Pre-open session), 09:00-09:08 for order collection and matching to determine the opening price, followed by continuous trading from 09:15; newly-listed/relisted securities use a separate Special Pre-open session (09:00-09:45)

cells.zh: 收盘集合竞价（Closing session，官网导航称Closing Auction Session/CAS），15:40-16:00
cells.en: Closing call auction (Closing session, referred to elsewhere on the site as the Closing Auction Session/CAS), 15:40-16:00

cells.zh: 订单驱动：NSE 交易系统（NEAT / NNF）为全电子中央订单簿，按价格优先、时间优先连续撮合；主板股票不设场内做市商。衍生品有流动性激励计划、SME 平台另设做市商制度
cells.en: Order-driven: the NSE trading system (NEAT / NNF) is a fully electronic central order book matching continuously on price-then-time priority; main-board equities have no on-exchange market makers. There is a Liquidity Enhancement Scheme for derivatives and a separate market-maker regime for the SME (NSE Emerge) platform

cells.zh: 价格优先、时间优先：订单进入系统后先加时间戳，随即尝试撮合，未成交的按价格-时间优先存入订单簿；最优买单（价高者）与最优卖单（价低者）撮合
cells.en: Price-then-time priority: incoming orders are time-stamped and immediately processed for a match; unmatched orders are stored in price-time priority, and the best buy order (highest price) matches the best sell order (lowest price)

cells.zh: 价格条件：限价单（Limit Order）、市价单（Market Order，按录入时可得最优价成交）、止损单（Stop Loss / SL Order，市场价触及或穿越阈值价时才激活）。时间条件：DAY（当日有效）、IOC（即时成交否则撤销，可部分成交、余量即撤）
cells.en: Price conditions: Limit orders, Market orders (filled at the best price obtainable when entered), and Stop Loss (SL) orders (activated only when the market price reaches or crosses a threshold). Time conditions: DAY (valid for the day) and IOC (Immediate-or-Cancel — partial fills allowed, the unmatched portion cancelled immediately)

cells.zh: 百分比涨跌幅，按证券监察分类分档（2%/5%/10%/20%），非全市场统一单一幅度
cells.en: Percentage price bands, tiered by surveillance/liquidity category (2%/5%/10%/20%), not a single uniform band market-wide

cells.zh: 个股按分类适用2%/5%/10%（either way）；挂有衍生品的个股无每日涨跌停，改设10%的委托申报操作区间（防止非真实价格挂单）；其余证券（含债券、优先股）20%；限价实物市场与Normal Market同幅度；Auction market统一20%
cells.en: 2%/5%/10% (either way) by security category; scrips with derivative products have no daily price band but a 10% order-entry operating range instead (to prevent non-genuine price orders); all remaining securities (incl. debentures, preference shares) 20%; the Limited Physical Market uses the same bands as the Normal Market; the Auction Market uses a flat 20%

cells.zh: 全市场指数熔断（index-based market-wide circuit breaker），三级阈值10%/15%/20%，以印度国家证券交易所Nifty 50或竞争对手孟买证券交易所（BSE）Sensex两个指数中先触发者为准
cells.en: Index-based market-wide circuit breaker, three-tier thresholds at 10%/15%/20%, triggered by whichever of the Nifty 50 (NSE) or the BSE Sensex breaches first

cells.zh: 见 circuit_breaker（全市场指数熔断）；个股级别的临时停牌/复牌具体规则本次未逐条核实
cells.en: See circuit_breaker (market-wide index circuit breaker); stock-level suspension/resumption rules not verified in detail this session

cells.zh: T+0（可当日回转）——现货市场为单一连续交易时段（09:15-15:30），未见对当日买入证券当日卖出的限制性表述
cells.en: T+0 (same-day round-trip trading permitted) — inferred from the single continuous trading session (09:15-15:30) with no same-day resale restriction found in the fetched pages

cells.zh: 设有证券借贷机制（Securities Lending and Borrowing Scheme, SLBS，2007-2008年度推出），但具体做空限制规则（如是否有报升规则、裸卖空禁令的条文表述）本次未能核实到直接原文
cells.en: A Securities Lending and Borrowing Scheme (SLBS) exists (introduced FY2007-2008), but the specific short-selling restriction rules (e.g. uptick-rule wording, naked short selling ban text) were not confirmed against direct source text this session

cells.zh: 披露为本，设有一组明确的量化财务门槛（实收股本/净资产/市值/营收等具体数值），叠加交易所对申请的自由裁量驳回权（如'6个月内曾被驳回'的冷静期条款、交易所可基于'任何交易所认为合适的理由'驳回申请）
cells.en: Disclosure-based, combining explicit quantitative financial thresholds (paid-up capital / net worth / market cap / revenue, etc.) with discretionary rejection powers reserved to the Exchange (e.g. a 6-month rejection cooling-off clause, and a catch-all 'any other reason as NSE may deem fit' rejection ground)

cells.zh: T+1（标准结算周期）；另有面向部分股票的T+0可选同日结算试点，与常规T+1并行、非强制
cells.en: T+1 (standard settlement cycle); an optional T+0 same-day settlement pilot also runs in parallel for select stocks, non-mandatory

cells.zh: NSE Clearing Limited（NCL，原National Securities Clearing Corporation Limited/NSCCL），NSE全资子公司
cells.en: NSE Clearing Limited (NCL, formerly National Securities Clearing Corporation Limited/NSCCL), a wholly-owned NSE subsidiary

cells.zh: 现货证券市场不适用实物/现金交割二选一；衍生品部分（股票/股指衍生品多数现金结算，商品/利率衍生品因品种而异）另见 clearing.derivatives.delivery_method
cells.en: Not applicable to the cash equities market; for derivatives (mostly cash-settled for equity/index derivatives, varies by instrument for commodity/interest-rate derivatives) see clearing.derivatives.delivery_method

cells.zh: NSE 按双侧计收交易费（transaction charges）：现货市场 Rs. 2.97/每边/每 lakh 成交金额；股指与股票期货 Rs. 1.73/每边/每 lakh；股票期权 Rs. 35.03/每边/每 lakh 权利金价值；货币期货 Rs. 0.35/每边/每 lakh；货币与利率期权 Rs. 31.10/每边/每 lakh 权利金价值。生效与修订后的费率见 detail
cells.en: NSE charges transaction charges on both sides: Cash Market Rs. 2.97 per lakh of traded value per side; Equity Futures Rs. 1.73 per lakh per side; Equity Options Rs. 35.03 per lakh of premium value per side; Currency Futures Rs. 0.35 per lakh per side; Currency and Interest Rate Options Rs. 31.10 per lakh of premium value per side; see detail for effective dates and later revisions

cells.zh: 印度自（官网原文 with effect from July 1, 2020）起通过证券交易所交易证券须缴印花税（Stamp Duty），由清算公司（经交易所授权）代征代缴：实物交割的股票转让 0.015%（买方）、非实物交割 0.003%（买方）、股票期货 0.002%（买方）、股票期权 0.003%（买方）。注意印度对证券交易同时征收印花税与证券交易税(STT)，二者为不同税目；其余品种（货币/利率衍生品、公司债、回购、政府证券等）税率见 detail
cells.en: From (per the official text, with effect from July 1, 2020) stamp duty on securities transactions through a stock exchange is levied and collected by Clearing Corporations authorised by the Exchange: delivery-based equity transfer 0.015% (buyer), non-delivery 0.003% (buyer), equity futures 0.002% (buyer), equity options 0.003% (buyer).
