Note India levies both stamp duty and STT on securities trades — distinct tax heads; rates for other instruments (currency/IR derivatives, corporate bonds, repo, government securities) are in detail

cells.zh: 公司制（母公司JPX由2013年东证集团与大阪证交所合并组成并上市）
cells.en: Demutualized (parent JPX formed by the 2013 merger of Tokyo Stock Exchange Group and Osaka Securities Exchange, then listed)

cells.zh: 并非TSE本身单独上市，而是母公司日本交易所集团（JPX）在TSE挂牌（2013年1月4日，当时为第一部）
cells.en: Not TSE itself; parent Japan Exchange Group (JPX) is listed on TSE (since January 4, 2013, originally on the 1st Section)

cells.zh: 日元 (JPY)
cells.en: JPY

cells.zh: 日元 (JPY)
cells.en: JPY

cells.zh: 金融厅
cells.en: Financial Services Agency (FSA)

cells.zh: Japan Exchange Regulation（JPX集团内设自律监管机构，2014年由「东京证券交易所自律监管法人」更名而来）；日本证券业协会（JSDA，经纪商会员层面）
cells.en: Japan Exchange Regulation (JPX Group's self-regulatory body, renamed from Tokyo Stock Exchange Regulation in 2014); Japan Securities Dealers Association (JSDA, broker-member level)

cells.zh: 《金融商品交易法》
cells.en: Financial Instruments and Exchange Act

cells.zh: 开盘集合竞价撮合决定开盘价，其后转为连续竞价
cells.en: Opening price determined by call auction, then continuous trading begins
Closing call auction, 3:25-3:30 p.m., executed at 3:30 p.m.

cells.zh: 订单驱动：TSE arrowhead 为全电子化中央订单簿，价格优先、时间优先连续竞价；现货股票市场没有场内指定做市商。仅交易所交易基金（ETF）设有『ETF 做市激励制度』——按品种指定做市商并要求持续双边报价
cells.en: Order-driven: TSE arrowhead is a fully electronic central order book matching on price then time priority; the cash equity market has no on-exchange designated market makers. Only ETFs have an 'ETF Market Making Incentive Scheme' under which market makers are designated per issue and required to post continuous two-sided quotes

cells.zh: 价格优先、时间优先；市价申报优先于指值申报
cells.en: Price priority, then time priority; market orders take precedence over limit orders

cells.zh: 市价申报（成行）、指值申报（限价申报）
cells.en: Market orders and limit orders

cells.zh: 值幅制限：按前收盘价（基准价）所在区间，分34档规定绝对日元值幅（非百分比），如100円未満±30円……5000万円超±1000万円。完整档位表见 main_board.spec.ladder
cells.en: Price limits on bids and offers: 34 tiers of absolute yen amounts (not percentages) keyed to the base price band, e.g. under 100 yen → ±30 yen ... more than 50,000,000 yen → ±10,000,000 yen. Full ladder in main_board.spec.ladder

cells.zh: 34 档绝对日元值幅表（见 spec.ladder），如 100 円未満 ±30 円、1000-1500 円 ±300 円、5000 万円超 ±1000 万円；档位随基准价升高放大
cells.en: 34-tier absolute-yen band table (see spec.ladder): e.g. under 100 yen ±30 yen, 1,000-1,500 yen ±300 yen, over 50,000,000 yen ±10,000,000 yen; the band widens as the base price rises

cells.zh: 无独立的全市场熔断机制（如美股MWCB）；波动控制主要通过「特別気配」（特别行情揭示）机制实现——申报价格超出值幅制限的基准价时，不直接成交，而是显示特别气配指示性价格，上午盘超出即不成交，下午盘则按值幅制限价位处理
cells.en: No separate market-wide circuit breaker (unlike the U.S. MWCB); volatility control operates primarily through the "special quote" mechanism — when an order price would exceed the price-limit band around the base price, no trade is executed at that price; instead a special indicative quote is displayed. In the morning session no transaction is effected; in the afternoon session trading is capped at the price limit

cells.zh: 同 circuit_breaker 所述的「特別気配」机制——本质是值幅制限的执行方式，而非独立的波动性中断层，与港交所VCM那种独立于涨跌停之外的冷静期机制不是同一类设计
cells.en: Same "special quote" mechanism described under circuit_breaker — it is the enforcement mechanism of the price-limit system itself, not a separate volatility-interruption layer distinct from price limits (unlike HKEX's VCM, which operates independently of any daily price limit since HKEX has none)

cells.zh: 见 circuit_breaker（特別気配）；另有因重大事项披露的停牌未逐条核实
cells.en: See circuit_breaker (special quote mechanism); halts for material disclosure events also exist but were not verified in detail

cells.zh: 现货股票交收前不得卖出（不可当日回转），与结算层面T+2（见 clearing.settlement_cycle）相配套
cells.en: Securities purchased may not be sold before settlement (no same-day round-trip); pairs with the T+2 settlement cycle (see clearing.settlement_cycle)

cells.zh: 卖空须向交易所披露（标记申报），且受价格限制约束（Rule 16「卖空价格限制基准价」），类似报升规则，具体触发比例本次未能在抓取内容中确认
cells.en: Short sales must be flagged/disclosed to the Exchange and are subject to a price restriction (Rule 16, "Base Prices with Short Selling Price Restriction"), functionally similar to an uptick rule; the specific trigger percentage was not confirmed in the content fetched this session

cells.zh: 现货股票市场无场内指定做市商。仅交易所交易基金（ETF）设有『ETF 做市激励制度』：交易所按品种、依交易参与者或高速交易者的申请指定 ETF 做市商，被指定者须按交易所规定持续提交双边报价，以促进 ETF 公允价格形成与流通
cells.en: The cash equity market has no on-exchange designated market makers. Only ETFs have an 'ETF Market Making Incentive Scheme': the Exchange designates ETF market makers per issue on application by trading participants or low-latency traders, and a designated market maker must post continuous two-sided quotes as specified by the Exchange to support fair price formation and circulation of ETFs

cells.zh: 披露为本，交易所设初次上市审查，重大事项另须向金融厅报告
cells.en: Disclosure-based; the Exchange conducts initial listing examinations, with major matters also reportable to the FSA

cells.zh: T+2（2019年7月16日起施行，此前更长）
cells.en: T+2 (effective July 16, 2019; previously longer)

cells.zh: 日本证券结算公司
cells.en: Japan Securities Clearing Corporation (JSCC)

cells.zh: 日本证券存管中心
cells.en: Japan Securities Depository Center, Inc. (JASDEC)

cells.zh: 不适用（现货市场，透过JASDEC电子簿记结算，无实物交割）
cells.en: Not applicable (cash market, book-entry settlement via JASDEC, no physical delivery)

cells.zh: TSE向交易参与者（证券公司）收取的交易参与费用由四部分构成：基本费用（Basic fees）、交易费用（Trading fees，按成交金额/量计）、接入费用（Access fees，按下单笔数计）、交易系统设施使用费（按交易系统使用状况计）；这是交易所向会员（而非终端投资者）收取的费用，终端投资者实际负担的部分通常已隐含在券商佣金中
cells.en: TSE's trading participation fees, paid by Trading Participants (brokers), are composed of four elements: Basic fees; Trading fees (based on trading value/volume); Access fees (based on the number of orders placed); and Trading system facility usage fees (based on the status of use of trading systems). These are fees the Exchange charges its members, not end investors directly — the investor-borne portion is typically embedded within broker commissions

cells.zh: 公司制（未上市）——依《资本市场与金融投资业法》(FSCMA)，交易所须为《商法》下的股份有限公司；股东名册全部为证券公司等金融机构与政府关联机构，非自身上市公司
cells.en: Demutualized (unlisted) — under the FSCMA, an Exchange must be a stock company under the Commercial Act; its shareholder registry consists entirely of securities firms and other financial/government-linked institutions, not a publicly listed entity

cells.zh: 否——股东名册（截至2019年末）由KB证券、Meritz证券、NH投资证券等国内证券公司及中小企业振兴公团等机构组成，未见自身股票代码或公开市场交易记录
cells.en: No — the shareholder registry (as of end-2019) is composed of domestic securities firms (KB Securities, Meritz Securities, NH Investment & Securities, etc.) and public agencies such as the Korea SMEs and Startups Agency; no own ticker or public trading record found

cells.zh: 韩元 (KRW)
cells.en: KRW

cells.zh: 韩元 (KRW)
cells.en: KRW

cells.zh: 金融委员会（Financial Services Commission, FSC）
cells.en: Financial Services Commission (FSC)

cells.zh: 市场监督委员会（Market Oversight Commission）——KRX内设的自律监管机构
cells.en: Market Oversight Commission — an internal self-regulatory body of the KRX

cells.zh: 《资本市场与金融投资业法》（Financial Investment Services and Capital Markets Act, FSCMA）
cells.en: Financial Investment Services and Capital Markets Act (FSCMA)

cells.zh: 开盘集合竞价（Periodic call auction）决定开盘价，其后转为连续竞价
cells.en: Opening price set by periodic call auction, then continuous auction begins

cells.zh: 收盘集合竞价（Periodic call auction）决定收盘价
cells.en: Closing price set by periodic call auction

cells.zh: 订单驱动：常规时段为中央电子订单簿连续竞价，按价格优先、时间优先原则即时撮合；一般股票无做市商。设『流动性提供者』（LP）制度，针对低流动性品种（ETF 另有专门 LP 制度）；流动性不足的个股改用单一价定期集合竞价而非连续竞价
cells.en: Order-driven: the regular session is continuous auction in a central electronic order book on price-then-time priority; ordinary stocks have no market makers. A Liquidity Provider (LP) scheme applies to low-liquidity instruments (ETFs have a dedicated LP System), and issues with insufficient liquidity are traded via periodic single-price call auctions rather than continuous auction

cells.zh: 常规时段为连续竞价：新申报（或修改后申报）收到后，按价格优先、时间优先原则即时撮合成交（低流动性品种不适用）
cells.en: Regular session is continuous auction: when new (or modified) orders are received, trade is executed immediately based on price priority and time priority (not applied to issues with low liquidity)

cells.zh: 限价申报、市价申报、限价转收盘价申报（Limit-to-market-On-close order）、即时可执行限价申报、最优限价申报、竞价型大宗交易申报，以及附带条件申报（FOK/IOC），各类型在开盘集合竞价/收盘集合竞价/盘前盘后/大宗交易等不同时段的可用性不同
cells.en: Limit Order, Market Order, Limit-to-market-On-close order, Immediately Executable Limit Order, Best Limit Order, Auction-based Block Trade Order, and Orders With Conditions (FOK, IOC) — availability of each type varies by session (opening/closing auction, pre/after-hours, block trade, etc.)

cells.zh: 涨跌停幅度限制：基准价的正负30%，KOSPI与KOSDAQ市场统一适用同一比例
cells.en: Daily price limit: ±30% of the base price, applied uniformly across both the KOSPI and KOSDAQ markets

cells.zh: ±30%（见 type 字段），该官方指南未按KOSPI/KOSDAQ分别列出不同幅度，两板统一适用
cells.en: ±30% (see the type field); the official guide does not list separate bands for KOSPI vs. KOSDAQ, both apply the same limit

cells.zh: 指数级三阶段熔断（Circuit Breakers）：第一阶段KOSPI（或KOSDAQ）指数较前日下跌8%以上（且持续1分钟），全市场暂停交易20分钟；第二阶段较前日下跌15%以上且较第一触发点再跌1%以上，熔断后以单一价格集合竞价10分钟恢复连续竞价；第三阶段较前日下跌20%以上且较第二触发点再跌1%以上，当日收市，所有申报（含撤单）不可再提交
cells.en: Three-phase index-level circuit breaker: Phase 1 — KOSPI (KOSDAQ) index falls 8% or more from the previous day (lasting one minute), entire market suspended 20 minutes; Phase 2 — falls 15% or more plus an additional 1% fall from the Phase-1 trigger, single-price call auction for 10 minutes after activation then resumes continuous auction; Phase 3 — falls 20% or more plus an additional 1% fall from the Phase-2 trigger, market closes for the day, no quotations (including cancellations) may be submitted

cells.zh: 个股级波动性中断（Volatility Interruption, VI），分动态VI与静态VI：连续竞价阶段VI触发后转为2分钟单一价格集合竞价；触发价 = 基准价 ± (基准价 × 触发比率)，KOSPI200成份股/ETF等常规交易时段动态VI比率±3%、静态VI比率±10%，其余品种动态VI比率±6%
cells.en: Individual-issue Volatility Interruption (VI), split into Dynamic VI and Static VI: when triggered during continuous auction, trading switches to a 2-minute single-price call auction; activation price = reference price ± (reference price × activation rate); for KOSPI 200 constituents/ETFs etc. the dynamic VI rate is ±3% and static VI rate ±10% during the regular session, while other issues use a ±6% dynamic rate

cells.zh: 个股停牌情形包括：上市公司披露重大信息后停牌30分钟；被指定为不实披露法人当日停牌；因传闻/报道引发交易量激增，须待澄清公告后方可复牌；公司未按要求答复问询（KOSPI从逾期到披露、KOSDAQ从逾期到披露后再加30分钟）；交易所认为有必要保护投资者时停牌1天；此外还有因退市事由、股票证书变更、结算会员未按期交收等其他停牌情形
cells.en: Individual-issue halts include: 30-minute suspension after a listed company discloses material information; one-day suspension upon designation as an unfaithful-disclosure corporation; suspension pending a clarifying announcement when a volume surge is likely due to rumors/news; suspension when a company fails to respond to a disclosure inquiry (KOSPI: from missed deadline to disclosure; KOSDAQ: from missed deadline to 30 minutes after disclosure); one-day suspension when the Exchange deems it necessary for investor protection; plus other grounds such as delisting causes, stock-certificate changes, and clearing-member settlement failures

cells.zh: 交易层面为 T+0（当日买入的证券当日即可卖出）——买单成交确认后即可提交对应卖单，属「当日回转交易」（same-day turnaround），不改变 T+2 净额交收（见 clearing.settlement_cycle）
cells.en: T+0 at the trading level (securities bought during the day may be sold the same day) — once a buy order's execution is confirmed the matching sell order may be entered as a same-day turnaround trade, without altering the T+2 netting settlement (see clearing.settlement_cycle)

cells.zh: 原则上禁止一切卖空，仅允许「担保卖空」（先借入证券再卖出）；担保卖空须遵守报升规则：卖空申报价格不得等于或低于最近成交价；投资者的净持仓卖空余额达到一定比例/金额须向交易所报告，达到另一（更高）比例须对外披露
cells.en: All types of short-selling are prohibited in principle; only covered short-selling (selling securities that have been borrowed) is permitted as an exception, subject to an uptick rule: short-selling orders may not be quoted at or under the most recently matched price; investors must report their net short-selling balance to the Exchange once it crosses certain ratio/value thresholds, and disclose publicly once it crosses a further (higher) threshold

cells.zh: 现货股票市场无场内一般性做市商制度；ETF 另设「流动性提供者」（Liquidity Provider, LP）制度：LP 原则上须同时提交买卖双边报价，若仅提交单边报价即可使市场价差比例落入 1% 以内，可豁免提交另一侧报价；市场价差比例超标或未履行报价义务达一定频次，交易所可要求基金管理公司更换 LP。
cells.en: The cash equity market has no general on-exchange market-maker scheme; ETFs have a separate Liquidity Provider (LP) scheme: in principle an LP must submit both bid and ask quotes, but may submit only one side if that already keeps the market spread ratio within 1%; if the spread-ratio requirement is breached or quoting obligations are unmet beyond a set frequency, the Exchange may require the fund management company to change the LP.

cells.zh: 由KRX交易所自身按量化门槛（经营年限、股本、股权分散度、财务表现、审计意见等多维标准，达标即可申请，非政府逐案审批）进行上市资格审查；与之并行，证券发行本身另受FSCMA下的证券注册制度约束（发行人向FSC提交证券申报书）——上市审核（交易所）与发行注册（FSC）是两套并行制度
cells.en: Listing eligibility is examined by the Exchange itself against quantitative thresholds (years in operation, equity capital, share distribution, financial performance, audit opinion, etc. — meeting the criteria enables application rather than case-by-case government approval); in parallel, the securities issuance itself is separately governed by FSCMA's registration regime (issuers file a securities registration statement with the FSC) — listing review (by the Exchange) and issuance registration (by the FSC) are two parallel systems

cells.zh: KOSPI市场设「管理股指定」与「退市」两级：管理股指定情形含未按期提交定期报告、审计意见为「保留/否定/无法表示意见」、资本侵蚀率50%以上、少数股东少于200人或持股比例低于5%、半年平均月成交量低于流通股1%、外部董事人数不足、不实披露累计扣分达10分以上、营收低于300亿韩元（2026年前为50亿、2026年为100亿、2027年为200亿韩元的过渡门槛，2027年起若最近年度平均市值达1000亿韩元以上可豁免）、市值连续30个交易日低于500亿韩元（2025年前为50亿、2026上半年为200亿、2026下半年为300亿韩元的过渡门槛）等；上述情形连续两年未解决或触发即时退市条款（如连续记录修正审计意见、逾期10日未交业务报告）则直接退市
cells.en: The KOSPI market uses a two-tier system — designation as an administrative issue, then delisting. Administrative-issue triggers include failure to submit periodic reports on time, a qualified/adverse/disclaimer audit opinion, a capital impairment ratio of 50% or more, fewer than 200 general shareholders or under 5% shareholding ratio, average monthly trading volume below 1% of free float for a half-year, an insufficient number of outside directors, 10+ accumulated penalty points for disclosure violations, sales below KRW 30 billion (phased-in thresholds of KRW 5bn until 2026, KRW 10bn in 2027, KRW 20bn in 2028), or market capitalization below KRW 50 billion for 30 consecutive trading days (phased-in thresholds of KRW 5bn until 2025, KRW 20bn in H1 2026, KRW 30bn in H2 2026); persistence of these conditions for two consecutive years, or immediate-delisting triggers (e.g. consecutive modified audit opinions, failure to submit a business report within 10 days of the deadline), lead directly to delisting

cells.zh: T+2（净额交收）
cells.en: T+2 (netting settlement)

cells.zh: 韩国交易所（KRX）本身——KRX直接担任证券与衍生品市场的中央对手方（CCP）
cells.en: Korea Exchange (KRX) itself — KRX directly acts as the CCP for both the securities and derivatives markets

cells.zh: 韩国证券存管院（Korea Securities Depository, KSD）——KRX持股70%的存管子公司，1974年设立
cells.en: Korea Securities Depository (KSD) — a depository subsidiary 70%-owned by KRX, established in 1974

cells.zh: 不适用（现货市场部分）——现货证券通过KSD电子簿记完成交收，无实物交割；衍生品部分（KOSPI200期货/期权等）另有交割安排，本次未展开
cells.en: Not applicable (for the cash market segment) — cash securities settle via KSD's electronic book-entry system, no physical delivery; the derivatives segment (KOSPI200 futures/options etc.) has separate delivery arrangements not explored this session

cells.zh: 交易所交易经手费：KRX对股票交易收取统一约0.0023%的交易费（精确实为0.0022763%），此单一费率已沿用近20年；为应对Nextrade竞争，2025年12月15日宣布临时改为阶梯费率——自2025年12月15日至2026年2月13日，限价单(Maker)费率降至0.00134%、市价单(Taker)降至0.00182%（原为统一0.0023%）。该临时下调按设计仅为期两个月（三个月以内的临时调整可由KRX自行决定，永久性下调须经金融委员会市场效率委员会审议）；到期后恢复统一0.0023%费率。衍生品按合约计收交易费。
cells.en: Exchange trading fee: KRX charges a flat stock trading fee of about 0.0023% (precisely 0.0022763%), a single rate in place for nearly 20 years; to counter competition from Nextrade it announced in Dec 2025 a temporary shift to a tiered rate — from 15 Dec 2025 to 13 Feb 2026, limit-order (Maker) fees drop to 0.00134% and market-order (Taker) fees to 0.00182% (from the prior flat 0.0023%). The temporary cut was time-boxed to two months by design (temporary cuts of under three months can be made by KRX itself, whereas a permanent reduction requires review by the Financial Services Commission's market efficiency committee); the flat 0.0023% is the standing rate after expiry. Derivatives are charged per contract.

cells.zh: 韩国对证券转让不征「印花税」(stamp duty)这一独立税种：韩国《印花税法》(Stamp Tax Act) 第1条明定印花税纳税义务人为『在韩国制备资产权利之设立、转让或变更之契约，或证明该交易之其他文书者』——课税对象是文书本身、纳税人是文书制备者，与证券的转让行为无涉；PwC 韩国『Other taxes』亦述韩国 stamp tax 对文书制备者课征 KRW 50–350,000。本项目横向对比中韩国的证券流转税是「证券交易税」(Securities Transaction Tax, STT)，现行税率见 financial_transaction_tax（2026年起KOSPI/KOSDAQ均为0.20%）。
cells.en: Korea does not impose a stamp duty as a separate tax on securities transfers: Article 1 of the Korean Stamp Tax Act imposes the stamp tax on 'a person who prepares a contract for the creation, transfer, or change of a right, etc. to an asset or any other documents certifying such transaction' — the tax is on the instrument and falls on its preparer, not on the securities transfer itself; PwC Korea 'Other taxes' corroborates (Korean stamp tax levied on document preparers, KRW 50–350,000). The transaction-value turnover tax in cross-exchange comparison is the 'Securities Transaction Tax' (STT), whose current rate is in financial_transaction_tax (0.20% for both KOSPI and KOSDAQ from 2026).

cells.zh: 公司制（股份公司），但运营实体本身未独立上市——见上方身份注释
cells.en: Demutualized (joint stock company), operating entity itself not separately listed

cells.zh: 运营实体本身（Saudi Exchange Company）未独立上市；母公司 Saudi Tadawul Group Holding Company 经股东特别大会决议（决议日期2021年4月6日）于2021年5月20日改制为控股集团，同年12月8日完成首次公开发行并在其自身运营的交易所挂牌交易（发行3600万股，占股本30%，发行价每股105里亚尔，发行后市值约126亿里亚尔）
cells.en: The operating entity (Saudi Exchange Company) is not itself listed; parent Saudi Tadawul Group Holding Company was converted into a holding company on 20 May 2021G pursuant to an Extraordinary General Assembly resolution dated 6 April 2021G, and completed its IPO on 8 December 2021, listing on the Exchange it operates (36,000,000 shares offered, 30% of share capital, at SAR 105 per share, implying a market cap of SAR 12.6bn at listing)

cells.zh: 沙特里亚尔（SAR）
cells.en: Saudi Riyal (SAR)

cells.zh: 沙特里亚尔（SAR）
cells.en: Saudi riyal (SAR)

cells.zh: 资本市场管理局
cells.en: Capital Market Authority (CMA)

cells.zh: Saudi Exchange 本身兼具前线监管职能（提出上市与交易相关规则、信息披露要求，报请CMA批准后实施）
cells.en: Front-line rule-making by the Exchange, subject to CMA Board approval

cells.zh: 《资本市场法》（王室法令 M/30 号，伊斯兰历1424年6月2日颁布）
cells.en: Capital Market Law (Royal Decree No. M/30, dated 2/6/1424H)

cells.zh: 第一时段开盘集合竞价（09:30–10:00，单一理论开盘价撮合）
cells.en: First Session Opening Auction (09:30–10:00)

cells.zh: 第三时段收盘集合竞价（15:00–15:10），随后第四时段（15:10–15:20）允许会员按收盘价继续按盘撮合（Trade at Last）
cells.en: Third Session Closing Auction (15:00–15:10), followed by Fourth Session Trade at Last (15:10–15:20)

cells.zh: 混合模式：全电子中央订单簿、价格优先-进入顺序连续撮合，叠加正式做市商制度——经资本市场管理局（CMA）董事会 2022 年批准的《做市商规则》管辖
cells.en: Hybrid: a fully electronic central order book matching on price then entry-order priority, overlaid with a formal market-maker regime governed by the Market Making Regulations approved by the CMA Board in 2022

cells.zh: 限价盘在同价位按订单进入顺序撮合；连续交易时段（第二时段）市价盘可部分/全部按单一价格成交
cells.en: Price-driven matching with entry-order priority at each price level in continuous trading

cells.zh: 限价盘（Limit Order）：可按对手方更优价成交，未成交部分继续按限价挂单；市价盘（Market Order）：第二时段内按当前价成交，未成交部分转为限价盘
cells.en: Limit Order and Market Order

cells.zh: 百分比涨跌幅限制（按前收盘价设定的当日涨跌幅 Daily Limit），叠加一个可在盘中随波动性拍卖滚动重设的静态限制（Static Limit）
cells.en: Percentage Band (Daily Limit off previous close), layered with a rolling Static Limit reset via intraday Volatility Auctions

cells.zh: ±10%（新股上市首3个交易日为±30%，第4日起收窄为±10%；ETF自上市首日起即为±10%）
cells.en: ±10% (±30% for the first 3 trading days after a new listing, narrowing to ±10% from day 4; ETFs are ±10% from day 1)

cells.zh: 无全市场熔断；个股/产品层级设静态限制（Static Limit ±10%）触发的波动性拍卖机制，非全面停牌
cells.en: No market-wide circuit breaker; stock-level Static Limit (±10%) triggers a Volatility Auction, not a full trading halt

cells.zh: 波动性拍卖（Volatility Auction）：盘中订单可能以静态限制±10%边界成交时触发，5分钟集合竞价冷静期，触发价成为新的静态基准价
cells.en: Volatility Auction: triggered when an order would match at the ±10% Static Limit boundary, 5-minute call-auction cooling-off, trigger price becomes the new static reference

cells.zh: 债券类证券因付息可暂停交易最长7个日历日；紧急情况下（依《交易与会员规则》第4条）可通过15分钟集合竞价恢复交易
cells.en: Debt Instruments may be suspended up to 7 calendar days for coupon payment; emergency situations may resume trading via a 15-minute auction

cells.zh: 交易层面为 T+0（当日买入的证券当日即可卖出）——Saudi Exchange 的 Trading and Membership Procedures 只规范申报、竞价与撮合，未设持有期或「交收前不得卖出」限制（结算层面见 clearing.settlement_cycle）
cells.en: T+0 at the trading level (securities bought during the day may be sold the same day) — the Saudi Exchange Trading and Membership Procedures govern only orders, auctions and matching, with no holding-period or 'may not sell before settlement' restriction (see clearing.settlement_cycle)

cells.zh: 受监管的备兑卖空（禁止裸卖空）：卖空订单须标记且已通过证券借贷协议锁定证券；默认覆盖除衍生品外全部上市证券（非指定清单），但须满足价格条件（卖出价须高于该证券当前最优买价，类报升规则）与两项动态限额（净空头持仓/最近60日日均成交量之比不超10日；净空头持仓不超过该证券自由流通量10%），触及限额的证券次一交易日禁止卖空
cells.en: Regulated covered short selling (naked short selling prohibited): orders must be flagged and covered under a securities borrowing and lending agreement; eligible by default for all listed securities except Derivatives (not a curated list), subject to a price condition (sale price must exceed the security's current best bid — an uptick-like rule) and two dynamic caps (net short position / 60-day average daily traded volume must not exceed 10 days; net short position must not exceed 10% of free float) — securities breaching either cap are barred from short selling the next Trading Day

cells.zh: 设有正式做市商制度，经CMA董事会2022年批准的《做市商规则》管辖；持有约束性证券借贷协议的做市商在从事做市活动时不适用卖空监管规则
cells.en: Formal Market Making Regulations approved by the CMA Board in 2022

cells.zh: 交易所实质审核制：交易所对申请材料进行审核并可自由裁量批准/拒绝，需委任财务顾问，重大事项另需CMA批准
cells.en: Exchange-led approval-based review with substantive discretion; financial advisor mandatory, key matters require separate CMA approval

cells.zh: CMA可在多种情形下随时暂停交易或取消上市，包括：为保护投资者/维护市场秩序认为有必要；发行人重大违反《资本市场法》/实施细则/交易所规则；未按时缴纳费用或罚款；发行人业务/资产已不再适合继续上市；累计亏损达资本50%以上并已向法院申请破产重整程序等
cells.en: CMA may suspend trading or cancel listing at any time on multiple grounds, incl. investor protection/orderly market, material rule breaches, unpaid fees/fines, unsuitability for continued listing, bankruptcy restructuring filings with accumulated losses ≥50% of capital

cells.zh: T+2（普通交易所交易）；场外协商交易可在T+0至T+5间另行约定；强制/自愿补仓交易（Buy-in）为T+0
cells.en: T+2 for normal exchange transactions; Negotiated Deals adjustable T+0–T+5; Buy-in trades settle T+0

cells.zh: 证券清算中心公司（Muqassa）
cells.en: Securities Clearing Center Company (Muqassa)

cells.zh: 证券存管中心公司（Edaa）
cells.en: Securities Depository Center Company (Edaa)

cells.zh: 股票现货为交割证券本身（记账式过户），不适用实物/现金交割二选一；衍生品部分另见 clearing.derivatives.delivery_method
cells.en: Cash equities settle via book-entry transfer of the securities themselves — not applicable to a physical/cash delivery choice; for derivatives see clearing.derivatives.delivery_method

cells.zh: 交易所交易费约为成交金额的 0.009%（由沙特交易所/Tadawul 收取）
cells.en: Exchange trading fee is approximately 0.009% of trade value (collected by Saudi Exchange / Tadawul)

cells.zh: 沙特对证券转让不征收印花税（stamp duty）
cells.en: Saudi Arabia does not impose stamp duty on securities transfers

cells.zh: 公司制（自身上市）
cells.en: Demutualized, Listed

cells.zh: 是（自2000年11月起在本所主板挂牌，股票代码 S68）
cells.en: Yes (listed on its own Mainboard since November 2000, ticker S68)

cells.zh: 新元为主；部分证券可另以美元等外币计价交易（月度统计报告区分「SGX Mainboard (S$)」与「SGX Mainboard (Non S$)」两类统计口径）
cells.en: Singapore Dollar (SGD) primarily; some securities are also quoted in foreign currencies (the official monthly statistics report separates "SGX Mainboard (S$)" and "SGX Mainboard (Non S$)" turnover)

cells.zh: 以交易货币结算，新元为主（见 trading_currency）
cells.en: Settled in the trading currency, predominantly Singapore dollars (see trading_currency)

cells.zh: 新加坡金融管理局（MAS）
cells.en: Monetary Authority of Singapore (MAS)

cells.zh: 新加坡交易所监管公司（SGX RegCo），SGX 集团下独立子公司，承担前线监管职能
cells.en: Singapore Exchange Regulation Pte. Ltd. (SGX RegCo), a dedicated subsidiary of the SGX Group carrying out front-line regulatory functions

cells.zh: 《证券期货法》（Securities and Futures Act 2001）
cells.en: Securities and Futures Act 2001 (SFA)

cells.zh: 开盘例行程序：Pre-Open阶段可自由报单/改单/撤单不撮合，Non-Cancel阶段不可再报单改单，按SGX-ST算法计算出成交量最大、失衡量最小的均衡价（Equilibrium Price）作为开盘价
cells.en: Opening Routine: order entry/amendment/withdrawal freely allowed without matching during Pre-Open; no new entry/amendment during Non-Cancel, where an Equilibrium Price (largest tradable volume, lowest imbalance) is computed as the opening price

cells.zh: 收盘例行程序（Pre-Close+Non-Cancel，机制与开盘例行程序对称）计算收盘均衡价，随后Trade at Close阶段仅允许按该均衡价继续撮合十分钟
cells.en: Closing Routine (Pre-Close + Non-Cancel, mirroring the Opening Routine) computes the closing Equilibrium Price, followed by a ten-minute Trade at Close Phase where matching continues only at that price

cells.zh: 订单驱动：中央电子限价订单簿，连续竞价按价格优先、时间优先撮合，开收盘按均衡价算法；一般股票无做市商。指定做市商（Designated Market-Maker）制度仅覆盖获批品种（ETF / 结构性权证 / DLC 等），须持续提供符合最大价差与最小数量要求的双边报价
cells.en: Order-driven: a central electronic limit order book matching on price-then-time priority in continuous trading and via an Equilibrium Price algorithm at the open and close; ordinary stocks have no market makers. A Designated Market-Maker scheme (SGX-ST Rules Chapter 6) covers only approved instruments (ETFs, structured warrants, DLCs, etc.), whose DMMs must provide continuous binding two-sided quotes within a prescribed maximum spread and minimum quantity

cells.zh: 连续竞价阶段按价格优先、时间优先撮合；开收盘及午间例行程序按均衡价算法撮合（见开盘/收盘机制）
cells.en: Continuous Trading Phase matches by price priority then time priority; Opening/Mid-Day/Closing routines match via the Equilibrium Price algorithm (see opening/closing mechanism)

cells.zh: 限价申报为主；交易系统亦支持市价申报（Market Order），均衡价算法专门处理市价盘造成的「市价盘剩余」情形；完整订单类型清单（如止损单、有效期类型）本次未逐条核实
cells.en: Primarily limit orders; the Trading System also supports Market Orders (the Equilibrium Price algorithm has a dedicated rule for a "Market Order Surplus"); a complete order-type/time-in-force enumeration was not individually verified this session

cells.zh: 动态参考价区间（Circuit Breaker）：非固定每日涨跌停，以滚动参考价±10%为价格带，官方原文明确区别于固定每日涨跌停模式
cells.en: Dynamic reference-price band (Circuit Breaker): not a fixed daily limit — a ±10% band around a rolling reference price; the rule text explicitly distinguishes this from a fixed daily price-limit model

cells.zh: 上限为参考价+10%，下限为参考价-10%；参考价在交易阶段开始时取当节开盘价（缺失则取前值），此后每5分钟滚动更新为5分钟前成交价；覆盖 STI/MSCI Singapore 成份股及参考价不低于 S$0.50 的股票/REIT/ETF 等（新股首日豁免）
cells.en: Upper threshold = reference price + 10%; lower threshold = reference price − 10%; the reference price starts as the session's opening price (falling back to prior values), then rolls every 5 minutes to the trade price from 5 minutes earlier

cells.zh: 个股/期货合约级别的熔断冷静期机制（Circuit Breaker / Cooling-Off Period），非全市场级
cells.en: Circuit Breaker / Cooling-Off Period — applies at the individual security/futures contract level, not market-wide

cells.zh: 冷静期（Cooling-Off Period）持续5分钟：撮合价超出价格带的委托将被拒绝，冷静期内交易仍可在价格带内继续进行（非停牌）；冷静期结束后价格带随新参考价调整；冷静期若与午休/收盘前阶段/停牌/暂停交易重叠则提前结束
cells.en: The Cooling-Off Period lasts 5 minutes: an incoming order that would match outside the band is rejected while trading continues within the band (not a halt); after the period ends the band is recalculated from the new reference price; the period ends early if it coincides with the Mid-Day Break, Pre-Close Phase, a suspension or a trading halt

cells.zh: 暂停交易后恢复时进入15分钟（可延长）的Adjust阶段，可报单改单撤单但不撮合，结束时按均衡价算法一次性撮合后恢复正常交易；一般性停牌权力条款本次未逐条核实
cells.en: Upon lifting a suspension, trading resumes via a 15-minute (extendable) Adjust Phase allowing order entry/amendment/withdrawal without matching, followed by a single Equilibrium-Price match before normal trading resumes; the general suspension-power provisions were not individually verified this session

cells.zh: T+0（当日买入证券可当日卖出）——本次抓取的交易/结算规则未见任何限制当日买卖的条款，与T+2结算（见clearing.settlement_cycle）是两个独立层面
基本无限制，但须标记卖单为「卖空/正常卖单」并申报数量；未见报升规则（uptick rule）或指定名单限制
cells.en: Largely unrestricted, subject to an order-marking/reporting regime (short sell orders must be flagged, with quantity disclosed); no uptick rule or designated-list restriction was found

cells.zh: 指定做市商（Designated Market-Maker）制度：须就获批品种在交易系统持续提供有约束力的双边报价，报价须在SGX-ST规定的最大价差与最小数量范围内
cells.en: Designated Market-Maker scheme: must continuously provide binding two-way quotations on the Trading System for approved instruments, within SGX-ST-prescribed maximum spread and minimum quantity

cells.zh: 混合制：主板为交易所量化门槛审核（利润/市值三选一测试），凯利板为保荐人主导的披露为本制度（保荐人对适合性负主责），全球上市板锚定Nasdaq上市标准，三板块审核逻辑并不统一
cells.en: Hybrid: Mainboard uses Exchange-vetted quantitative admission tests; Catalist is a disclosure-based, sponsor-supervised regime where the sponsor bears primary responsibility for suitability; the Global Listing Board anchors to Nasdaq listing standards — the three boards do not share one review philosophy

cells.zh: 交易所可依职权将发行人从官方名单剔除的情形包括：无法/不愿遵守上市规则、维护公平有序透明市场所需、交易所认为适当、已无上市证券，或SPAC触发特定条款；发行人主动申请退市须获至少75%独立股东（按票数，出席并投票）批准
cells.en: The Exchange may remove an issuer from the Official List where the issuer is unable/unwilling to comply with a listing rule, it is necessary for a fair/orderly/transparent market, the Exchange considers it appropriate, the issuer has no listed securities, or (for SPACs) specified triggers occur; a voluntary delisting requires approval by at least 75% of independent shareholders present and voting

cells.zh: T+2（现货证券「Ready market」）；可保证金交易的期货合约为「最后交易日+2」（LTD+2）；因结算失败而产生的强制补进（buying-in）市场为T+1
cells.en: T+2 for the securities Ready market; "Last Trading Day + 2" (LTD+2) for Marginable Futures Contracts; T+1 for the buying-in market arising from settlement failures

cells.zh: 现货证券：新加坡中央存托私人有限公司（CDP）；衍生品：新加坡交易所衍生品结算有限公司（SGX-DC）
cells.en: Securities: The Central Depository (Pte) Limited (CDP); Derivatives: Singapore Exchange Derivatives Clearing Limited (SGX-DC)

cells.zh: 新加坡中央存托私人有限公司（CDP），身兼证券中央对手方与中央存管机构双重角色（与港交所HKSCC模式相同）
cells.en: The Central Depository (Pte) Limited (CDP), serving as both CCP and CSD for securities (the same combined-role model as HKEX's HKSCC)

cells.zh: 现货证券市场（SGX-ST）不适用实物/现金交割二选一（证券记账过户，由CDP清算）；衍生品部分（SGX-DT）另见 clearing.derivatives.delivery_method
cells.en: Not applicable to the securities market (SGX-ST) — settlement is book-entry securities transfer cleared by CDP, not a physical/cash delivery choice; for derivatives (SGX-DT) see clearing.derivatives.delivery_method

cells.zh: SGX 对现货证券交易收取「交易费」（SGX Trading Fee），业界与券商公开费率表口径约为成交金额的 0.0075%；此外 CDP 另收证券清算/存管相关费用。衍生品交易/清算费按合约计收，与本字段现货口径不同。本数值来自第三方券商费率综述，本次未抓取到 sgx.com 逐字费率表，故标 medium。
cells.en: SGX levies a securities Trading Fee, cited by industry/broker fee schedules at roughly 0.0075% of contract value; CDP separately charges securities clearing/custody fees. Derivatives trading/clearing fees are per-contract and differ from this securities figure. The rate is from third-party broker fee overviews; no verbatim sgx.com fee table was fetched, so confidence is medium.

cells.zh: 无纸化（scripless）股票经CDP电子过户免征印花税，依《印花税（豁免记录）规则》2018
cells.en: Electronic transfers of scripless shares via CDP are exempt from stamp duty under the Stamp Duties (Exempt Record) Rules 2018

cells.zh: 公司制（股份有限公司，未上市）
cells.en: Corporate/demutualized form (a company limited by shares; itself unlisted)

cells.zh: 否
cells.en: No

cells.zh: 新台币
cells.en: New Taiwan Dollar (NT$)

cells.zh: 新台币
cells.en: New Taiwan dollar (TWD)

cells.zh: 金融监督管理委员会
cells.en: Financial Supervisory Commission (FSC)

cells.zh: 中华民国证券商业同业公会
cells.en: Taiwan Securities Association (TWSA)

cells.zh: 《证券交易法》
cells.en: Securities and Exchange Act

cells.zh: 开盘集合竞价：当市第一次撮合采集合竞价，8:30-9:00仅接受限价当日有效(ROD)委托，9:00依集合竞价原则决定开盘价
cells.en: Opening Call Auction: the first matching of the day uses call auction; only Limit-ROD orders accepted 8:30-9:00, matched at 9:00

cells.zh: 收盘集合竞价：13:25-13:30汇集一段时间内所有申报以集合竞价方式决定收盘价；收盘前最后1分钟若模拟成交价较前次波动超逾3.5%者，延后2分钟至13:33收盘
cells.en: Closing Call Auction: orders accumulated 13:25-13:30 are matched by call auction; certain volatile stocks are delayed to 13:33

cells.zh: 订单驱动：集中市场为全电子中央订单簿，依价格优先、时间优先原则逐笔撮合成交；一般股票不设做市商。仅对经交易所每年筛选的『优质低流动性股票』实施股票造市者及交易奖励参与者制度
cells.en: Order-driven: the centralised market is a fully electronic central order book matching order-by-order on price-then-time priority; ordinary stocks have no market makers. A Stock Market Maker and Trading Incentive Participant scheme applies only to 'quality low-liquidity stocks' selected annually by the Exchange

cells.zh: 价格优先、时间优先
cells.en: Price priority and time priority

cells.zh: 六种委托方式：价格种类（限价/市价）× 存续类别（当日有效ROD / 立即成交或取消IOC / 全部成交或取消FOK）；逐笔交易时段六种皆可用，开收盘集合竞价时段仅接受限价ROD
cells.en: Six order types: Limit/Market price x Rest-of-Day (ROD) / Immediate-or-Cancel (IOC) / Fill-or-Kill (FOK); only Limit-ROD accepted during call auctions

cells.zh: 百分比涨跌幅
cells.en: Percentage-based price band

cells.zh: ±10%，以当市开盘竞价基准（通常为前一交易日收盘价）为计算基准，非以前收盘价直接乘幅度；2015年6月1日起由±7%放宽至±10%
cells.en: ±10% of the auction reference price at market opening of the current trading session

cells.zh: 无指数级/全市场熔断机制；仅有个股级「瞬间价格稳定措施」（延后撮合而非全面停止交易）
cells.en: No index-level/market-wide circuit breaker; only a stock-level "price stabilization" measure (delays matching rather than halting trading market-wide)

cells.zh: 瞬间价格稳定措施：逐笔交易时段内，任一试算成交价超出「前5分钟滚动加权平均价」（9:00-9:05以开盘价为基准）上下3.5%，即暂缓该证券撮合2分钟，2分钟后以集合竞价撮合成交，其后恢复逐笔交易；权证及新上市首5日无涨跌幅股票不适用本措施
cells.en: Instantaneous Price Stabilization Measures: continuous-auction matching is paused for 2 minutes and resumed via call auction whenever a trial price moves ±3.5% beyond the trailing 5-minute weighted average price

cells.zh: 讯息面暂停/恢复交易机制（2016年1月15日起实施）：上市公司预计于交易时间内公开重大事项应主动申请暂停交易，相关讯息充分揭露后再申请恢复；另有台湾存托凭证(TDR)因所表彰证券于原上市市场公告暂停交易而联动暂停之机制
cells.en: Information-driven halt/resumption mechanism (effective since 15 Jan 2016): a listed company that expects to disclose a material matter during trading hours must proactively apply to halt trading, then apply for resumption once the information has been adequately disclosed; Taiwan Depositary Receipts (TDRs) are also halted in tandem when the underlying security is suspended on its original home market

cells.zh: 一般交割周期为T+2，但现股当日冲销交易（先买后卖自2014年1月6日、先卖后买自2014年6月30日起开放）允许同一帐户同日买卖同种类同数量股票以差额净沖，不必等待T+2交割完成；沖销标的以公告之信用交易/当沖标的清单为限，非全市场无差别适用
cells.en: Regular settlement is T+2, but same-day (day-trading) offsetting transactions in cash stock — buy-then-sell opened 6 Jan 2014, sell-then-buy opened 30 Jun 2014 — allow the same account to buy and sell the same class and quantity of shares on the same day and net the difference, without waiting for T+2 settlement; eligible securities are limited to the published margin-trading/day-trading-eligible list, not applied indiscriminately market-wide

cells.zh: 融资融券（信用交易）及借券卖出机制；仅限公告之融资融券标的证券方可信用交易。2013年9月23日起，平盘以下得融(借)券卖出之标的已扩大至所有得为融资融券标的之证券（此前范围更窄）；对不在放宽清单内的证券，平盘以下不得改价放空
cells.en: Margin Trading (融資) and Securities Lending Short Sale (融券/借券賣出); short sales below the reference (last) price are restricted except for securities on the published margin-eligible list

cells.zh: 股票造市者及交易奖励参与者制度，2021年6月30日起实施，参考新加坡及韩国市场造市制度；证券自营商可择一申请担任「股票造市者」或「交易奖励参与者」，本公司按获利水准、成交量、周转率等标准每年筛选「优质低流动性股票」并提供经手费折让等奖励
cells.en: Stock Market Maker and Trading Incentive Participant Scheme (effective 30 June 2021, modeled on Singapore and Korea)

cells.zh: 交易所实质审查制：TWSE 依《有价证券上市审查准则》对设立年限、实收资本额、获利能力、股权分散等量化门槛进行审查，审定后与发行公司签订「有价证券上市契约」，报请金管会备查（非金管会逐案核准）；本国公司申请上市前一般须先在兴柜市场挂牌满6个月
cells.en: Substantive review by the exchange itself: TWSE reviews applicants against quantitative thresholds — years in operation, paid-in capital, profitability, and shareholding dispersion — under the Listing Review Standards; once approved it enters into a listing agreement with the issuer and reports it to the FSC for the record (not case-by-case FSC approval); domestic companies generally must first be registered on the Emerging Stock (Rotan) market for at least 6 months before applying to list

cells.zh: 《营业细则》第五十条之一规定十九款终止上市法定情事，本公司应终止其上市并报请主管机关备查。其中主要量化门槛包括：最近期财务报告显示净值为负数者；上市特别股发行总额低于新台币二亿元或发行股数低于二千万股者；依第五十条规定停止买卖连续满六个月仍未恢复其买卖者；营业全面停顿六个月无法恢复，或连续六个月公告之营业收入为零或负数者；为另一已上市（柜）公司持有股份逾其已发行股份总数或实收资本额百分之七十以上者；自上市挂牌日起届满一年后该股票已在证券柜台买卖中心上柜者。此外还包括公司经裁定解散、宣告破产确定、裁定准予重整确定等公司主体消灭情事，以及经主管机关命令停止全部有价证券买卖达三个月以上等重大违规情事，合计十九款，全文见 quote
cells.en: Business Operation Rules Article 50-1 sets out nineteen statutory grounds on which TWSE must terminate a company's listing and report it to the regulator. Key quantitative triggers include: negative net worth per the most recent financial report; total issued preferred stock below New Taiwan dollars two hundred million, or fewer than twenty million shares; a trading suspension under Article 50 that remains unresolved for six consecutive months; a full business halt for six months with no resumption, or reported operating revenue at zero or negative for six consecutive months; more than seventy percent of issued shares or paid-in capital held by another listed/OTC-listed company; and remaining OTC-listed for over one year after the TWSE listing date. Other grounds include company dissolution, bankruptcy, or court-approved reorganization, and a regulator-ordered suspension of all securities trading lasting three months or more

cells.zh: T+2（普通交割，成交日后第二营业日；买进应付款/卖出应付券于第二营业日上午10时前交割，应收款/券于当日上午11时后取得）
cells.en: T+2 (regular settlement, second business day after trade date)

cells.zh: 台湾证券交易所本身承担中央对手方之实质角色：与会员证券商按证券/款项分别进行多边净额沖抵计算，任一方不履行交割义务时由本公司指定其他证券商代为交付；台湾并未另设与交易所法律上分离的独立CCP法人实体
cells.en: Taiwan Stock Exchange Corporation itself performs the de facto CCP function via multilateral netting with member brokers; there is no separate CCP entity distinct from the exchange

cells.zh: 台湾集中保管结算所股份有限公司（TDCC）
cells.en: Taiwan Depository & Clearing Corporation (TDCC)

cells.zh: 不适用（现货市场，无实物/现金交割概念；采款券帐簿划拨方式完成结算）
cells.en: Not applicable (a cash market with no physical-/cash-delivery concept in the derivatives sense; settlement is completed via book-entry transfer of funds and securities)

cells.zh: 证券交易税（税率千分之三，即0.3%，向出卖人按每次成交金额单边课征）；现股当日冲销交易减半课征至千分之一点五（0.15%），优惠期限延长至民国116年（2027年）12月31日止
cells.en: Securities Transaction Tax: 0.3% levied on the seller per trade for stocks; reduced to 0.15% for same-day (day-trading) offsetting transactions, extended through 31 December 2027

cells.zh: 公司制（2001年7月由会员制改制为公众公司）
cells.en: Demutualized (became a public company in July 2001)

cells.zh: 2001年7月LSE本身曾作为独立公众公司在自己市场挂牌；2007年10月与Borsa Italiana合并组成LSEG集团后，当前的挂牌主体是集团控股公司London Stock Exchange Group plc（LSEG plc），而非“伦敦证券交易所”这一运营法人实体本身
cells.en: London Stock Exchange itself listed on its own market in July 2001; following the October 2007 merger with Borsa Italiana that formed LSEG, the entity currently listed is the group holding company, London Stock Exchange Group plc, rather than the operating exchange entity itself

cells.zh: 英镑（GBP）为主；国际预托凭证及部分交易所买卖产品（ETP）等品类另有多币种报价（如以Euroclear Bank结算的ETP）
cells.en: Primarily GBP; certain segments such as international depositary receipts and some ETPs quote in other currencies (e.g. ETPs settled via Euroclear Bank)

cells.zh: 英镑（GBP）为主，经CREST（由Euroclear UK & International运营）结算；部分品类另有多币种结算安排
cells.en: Primarily GBP, settled via CREST (operated by Euroclear UK & International); certain instruments have multi-currency settlement arrangements

cells.zh: 金融行为监管局（Financial Conduct Authority, FCA）——作为英国上市监管机关（UK Listing Authority职能），维护官方名册（Official List）并制定UK Listing Rules（UKLR）
cells.en: Financial Conduct Authority (FCA) — acts as the UK Listing Authority, maintains the Official List and makes the UK Listing Rules (UKLR)

cells.zh: 伦敦证券交易所本身作为“认可投资交易所”（Recognised Investment Exchange, RIE），对市场准入交易与市场运作承担一线监管职责，须遵守FCA就RIE制定的监管手册（sourcebook）要求
cells.en: London Stock Exchange itself, as a Recognised Investment Exchange (RIE) under UK law, carries front-line responsibility for admission to trading and market operation, subject to the FCA's sourcebook for Recognised Investment Exchanges

cells.zh: 《2000年金融服务与市场法》（Financial Services and Markets Act 2000, FSMA）
cells.en: Financial Services and Markets Act 2000 (FSMA)

cells.zh: 开盘集合竞价（Opening Auction Call）
cells.en: Opening Auction Call

cells.zh: 收盘集合竞价，随后进入短暂的收盘价交叉时段（CPX），允许以收盘价继续撮合剩余订单
cells.en: Closing Auction, followed by a brief Closing Price Crossing Session (CPX) allowing continued execution at the closing auction price

cells.zh: 混合模式：核心为中央电子限价订单簿（Millennium Exchange）连续撮合；同时并行两套注册做市商制度——订单驱动品种（SETS/IOB 等）做市商以可执行报价参与订单簿，报价驱动品种（SETSqx/SEAQ/欧洲报价服务，多为流动性较低的证券）由注册做市商以确定报价提供流动性
cells.en: Hybrid: at its core a central electronic limit order book (Millennium Exchange) with continuous matching, running alongside two parallel registered market-maker regimes — market makers in order-driven instruments (SETS, IOB, etc.) quote Executable Quotes into the book, while quote-driven instruments (SETSqx, SEAQ, European Quoting Service — largely less liquid securities) rely on registered market makers providing Firm Quotes

cells.zh: 价格优先原则（Millennium Exchange以价格优先为基础运作）；同价位内展示订单优先于非展示订单（冰山订单非展示部分＞完全隐藏订单＞中间价挂钩订单），除冰山订单非展示部分外，各类别内部再按提交时间优先排序
cells.en: Price priority (Millennium Exchange operates on a price priority basis); at the same price, displayed order portions take precedence over non-displayed portions (iceberg non-display > fully hidden orders > mid-price pegged orders), each category then time-prioritised except for the non-displayed iceberg portion

cells.zh: 限价订单（Limit Order）、市价订单（Market Order，无价格优先于所有限价订单）、止损订单/止损限价订单（Stop/Stop Limit Order）、冰山订单（Iceberg Order，仅展示部分数量）、隐藏限价订单（Hidden Limit Order）、中间价挂钩订单（Mid-Price Pegged Order，仅在盘中以买卖中间价成交）
cells.en: Limit Order, Market Order (unpriced, has price priority over all priced orders), Stop / Stop Limit Order, Iceberg Order (displays only a portion of total volume), Hidden Limit Order (non-displayed), Mid-Price Pegged Order (executes only at the mid BID/OFFER price during regular trading)

cells.zh: 非固定百分比涨跌停板，而是逐证券（security-by-security）的价格监控机制——静态价格监控（相对开盘集合竞价价格的偏离阈值）与动态价格监控（相对最近成交价的偏离阈值）触发后，转入波动性拍卖重新形成价格，而非直接停牌
cells.en: Not a fixed percentage limit-up/limit-down band; instead a security-by-security price monitoring mechanism — static price monitoring (deviation from the opening auction price) and dynamic price monitoring (deviation from the last traded price) trigger a volatility auction to re-form the price, rather than a straight halt

cells.zh: 以富时100成分股为例：静态价格监控阈值8%（相对上一次集合竞价成交价），动态价格监控阈值3%（相对最近成交价，触发5分钟波动性拍卖，含最多一次2分钟市价订单延期）；次一流动性梯队（如LSE行业分类FS10）静态阈值10%、动态阈值5%；富时100盘中/收盘/EDSP拍卖的动态阈值比常规交易更紧（FE10为1%，FS10为3%）
cells.en: For FTSE 100 constituents: static price monitoring threshold 8% (vs. last auction uncrossing price), dynamic threshold 3% (vs. last traded price, triggering a 5-minute volatility auction with up to one 2-minute Market Order extension); the next liquidity tier (e.g. LSE sector FS10) uses 10% static / 5% dynamic; FTSE 100 intraday/closing/EDSP auctions use tighter dynamic thresholds than regular trading (1% for FE10, 3% for FS10)

cells.zh: 个股级价格监控机制（无美股式全市场熔断）：不同于美国基于标普500指数跌幅触发的全市场熔断（暂停全部股票交易15分钟），伦敦证券交易所采用逐证券的价格监控功能
cells.en: Stock-level price monitoring mechanism (no US-style market-wide circuit breaker): unlike US market-wide circuit breakers that pause all stocks for 15 minutes based on S&P 500 declines, LSE employs a security-by-security price monitoring mechanism

cells.zh: 静态价格监控（Static Price Monitoring）与动态价格监控（Dynamic Price Monitoring）触发后转入波动性拍卖（volatility auction），价格重新形成后恢复常规交易；每次拍卖及延期后另设最长30秒随机时间
cells.en: Static and Dynamic Price Monitoring trigger a volatility auction; once the price re-forms, regular trading resumes; each auction/extension is followed by a random period of up to 30 seconds

cells.zh: 两套并行机制：(1) FCA可依UKLR暂停/取消证券上市（如未达持续义务、市场平稳运行受威胁等，暂停满6个月须与FCA讨论是否取消上市）；(2) 交易所自身的技术性市场干预（Service Interruptions Protocol）——因系统故障等严重事件，可对受影响证券实施Halt（禁止新订单但可撤单）、Suspension（订单簿冻结，禁止新增和撤销）或Halt and Close（当日不再恢复交易，直接设定收盘价）三种状态之一
cells.en: Two parallel mechanisms: (1) the FCA may suspend/cancel a listing under UKLR (e.g. failure to meet continuing obligations, threat to orderly market operation; after 6 months of suspension the issuer must discuss cancellation with the FCA); (2) the Exchange's own technical market interventions under its Service Interruptions Protocol — for major system outages, affected securities may be placed into Halt (no new orders, deletions allowed), Market/Partition Suspension (order book frozen, no new orders or deletions) or Halt and Close (trading will not resume that day; a closing price is set)

cells.zh: 交易层面为 T+0（当日买入的证券当日即可卖出）——LSE 的 MIT201 交易系统指南与 Rules of the London Stock Exchange 只规范订单簿运作、竞价与撮合，未设持有期或「交收前不得卖出」限制；结算层面为 T+2（见 clearing.settlement_cycle；英国已定于 2027-10-11 改 T+1）
cells.en: T+0 at the trading level (securities bought during the day may be sold the same day) — the LSE's MIT201 Guide to the Trading System and the Rules of the London Stock Exchange govern only order-book operation, auctions and matching, with no holding-period or 'may not sell before settlement' restriction; settlement is T+2 (see clearing.settlement_cycle)

cells.zh: 《2025年卖空规则》（Short Selling Regulations 2025, SSR 2025）——脱欧后英国自订的独立卖空监管框架，2026年7月13日起正式取代此前“承接”的欧盟《卖空条例》（Regulation (EU) No 236/2012）。持有可报告股票净空头仓位达0.2%阈值须向FCA报告，FCA公布匿名化的汇总净空头仓位（ANSP）；FCA保留在特殊情形下实施限制/禁止卖空的紧急权力
cells.en: Short Selling Regulations 2025 (SSR 2025) — the UK's own post-Brexit short-selling framework, which from 13 July 2026 replaced the previously-assimilated EU Short Selling Regulation (Regulation (EU) No 236/2012). Net short positions in reportable shares must be notified to the FCA once the 0.2% threshold is reached; the FCA publishes anonymised Aggregate Net Short Positions (ANSP); the FCA retains emergency powers to restrict or ban short selling in exceptional circumstances

cells.zh: 分订单驱动与报价驱动两套做市商制度：SETS/IOB/证券化衍生品/固定收益订单簿等订单驱动品种，注册做市商以可执行报价（Executable Quotes）参与；SETSqx/SEAQ/欧洲报价服务等报价驱动品种，注册做市商以非电子可执行的确定报价（Firm Quotes）参与，且仅具备中央对手方清算资格的会员机构方可注册为报价驱动品种做市商
cells.en: Two parallel market maker regimes: order-driven instruments (SETS, IOB, securitised derivatives, fixed income order book) use registered market makers quoting Executable Quotes; quote-driven instruments (SETSqx, SEAQ, European Quoting Service) use registered market makers providing non-electronically-executable Firm Quotes, and only member firms with central counterparty clearing capability may register as quote-driven market makers

cells.zh: 披露为本，2024年7月UKLR改革后以单一“股票证券（商业公司）”类别取代此前Premium/Standard两级架构；申请人须在多类触发事件（如须发布招股说明书、反向收购通函等）委任一名保荐人（Sponsor）向FCA确认其符合UKLR相关要求
cells.en: Disclosure-based; following the July 2024 UKLR reform, a single 'equity shares (commercial companies)' category replaced the previous two-tier Premium/Standard structure. Issuers must appoint a Sponsor on multiple trigger events (e.g. when a prospectus or reverse-takeover circular is required) to confirm compliance with the relevant UKLR requirements to the FCA

cells.zh: FCA认定存在阻碍证券正常常规交易的特殊情形即可取消上市，典型触发情形包括：证券已不再符合本规则要求获准交易；发行人不再满足持续义务（如公众持股比例跌破10%，FCA可给予合理期限恢复但受市场平稳运行/投资者保护需要限制）；暂停上市已满6个月；发行人完成反向收购或“初始交易”（initial transaction）
cells.en: The FCA may cancel a listing where it is satisfied that special circumstances preclude normal regular dealings, including: securities no longer admitted to trading as required; the issuer no longer satisfying continuing obligations (e.g. shares in public hands falling below 10%, subject to a reasonable restoration period unless precluded by market-order/investor-protection needs); the listing having been suspended for more than 6 months; or the issuer completing a reverse takeover or 'initial transaction'

cells.zh: T+2（现行）；英国计划于2027年10月11日整体切换为T+1，本次核实时点（2026-08-14）尚未生效
cells.en: T+2 (current); the UK is planning a market-wide move to T+1 on 11 October 2027, which had not yet taken effect as of this session's verification date (2026-08-14)

cells.zh: LCH Ltd——LSEG集团清算业务（LCH集团）旗下英国主体，作为中央对手方为包括股票在内的多资产类别提供清算服务
cells.en: LCH Ltd — the UK entity of LSEG's clearing business (LCH Group), acting as central counterparty across multiple asset classes including equities

cells.zh: CREST——由Euroclear UK & International Ltd运营的英国证券结算系统
cells.en: CREST — the UK securities settlement system, operated by Euroclear UK & International Ltd

cells.zh: 不适用（现货市场，无实物/现金交割概念）
cells.en: Not applicable (cash market; no physical/cash delivery concept)

cells.zh: 会员交易费：按月度累计成交金额分档收取基点费率（Standard value traded scheme：首£35亿0.45个基点，其后£50亿0.35个基点，超出部分0.25个基点，月度封顶£15,000），另设流动性提供计划（Liquidity Provider Scheme）对被动成交给予返佣（负费率）；发行人上市费：股票类新上市按市值分级累进收取（如£0-5百万区间为最低费£17,600，此后每百万递增£2,305……最高累计£698,000+20%增值税），另按上市证券市值每年收取年费（如£175百万市值对应年费£11,750，按每百万£60递增，上限£265,000）
cells.en: Member trading fees: tiered basis-point rates by monthly cumulative value traded (Standard value traded scheme: 0.45bp on the first £3.5bn, 0.35bp on the next £5bn, 0.25bp thereafter, capped at £15,000/month), plus a Liquidity Provider Scheme offering rebates (negative fees) for passive execution; issuer fees: admission fees for new equity listings are tiered by market capitalisation (e.g. minimum fee £17,600 for the £0-5m band, then £2,305 per additional £1m... cumulative maximum £698,000 plus 20% VAT), plus an annual fee based on listed market capitalisation (e.g. £11,750 minimum for a £175m market cap, £60 per £1m thereafter, capped at £265,000)

cells.zh: 印花税（Stamp Duty）：纸质转让文书形式、金额超£1,000的证券交易，税率0.5%（就近取整至£5）；印花税储备税（Stamp Duty Reserve Tax, SDRT）：电子（无纸化）交易，税率0.5%（就近取整至1便士），经CREST系统自动代收并划付予英国税务海关总署（HMRC）。征收方向为买方——HMRC 官方指引明示『买入股票时缴纳』（you pay tax when you buy）
cells.en: Stamp Duty: 0.5% (rounded to the nearest £5) on paper-form share transfers over £1,000; Stamp Duty Reserve Tax (SDRT): 0.5% (rounded to the nearest 1p) on electronic (paperless) transactions, automatically collected via CREST and remitted to HMRC. The tax is borne by the buyer — HMRC guidance states plainly that 'you pay tax when you buy' shares

cells.zh: 公司制（由NASD旗下子公司改制为独立上市公司，2005年以NDAQ代码上市）
cells.en: Demutualized, listed (converted from an NASD subsidiary to an independent public company, listed under NDAQ in 2005)

cells.zh: Nasdaq, Inc. 自身普通股以代码NDAQ公开交易（与港交所模式类似，自身上市于自己的市场）
cells.en: Nasdaq, Inc.'s own common stock trades publicly under the symbol NDAQ

cells.zh: 美元 (USD)
cells.en: USD

cells.zh: 美元 (USD)
cells.en: USD

cells.zh: 美国证券交易委员会
cells.en: U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC)

cells.zh: Nasdaq自身监管职能部门（MarketWatch股票/期权市场监察、调查与执法、上市审核三大团队，独立于业务部门运作）；FINRA代表纳斯达克会员机构提供部分监管服务
cells.en: Nasdaq's own regulatory functions (MarketWatch equities/options surveillance, Investigations & Enforcement, Listing Qualifications — operating independently of Nasdaq's business units); FINRA provides regulatory services on Nasdaq's behalf for its members

cells.zh: 《1934年证券交易法》（Securities Exchange Act of 1934）——纳斯达克作为SEC注册的全国性证券交易所须依据该法第6条完成注册
cells.en: Securities Exchange Act of 1934 — Nasdaq is registered as a national securities exchange under Section 6 of this Act

cells.zh: 开盘集合竞价（Opening Cross），9:25-9:30am发布订单失衡信息，9:30am撮合成交
cells.en: Opening Cross at 9:30 a.m. ET, preceded by Net Order Imbalance Indicator dissemination from 9:25 a.m.

cells.zh: 收盘集合竞价（Closing Cross），3:50pm起发布订单失衡信息，4:00pm撮合成交
cells.en: Closing Cross at 4:00 p.m. ET, preceded by Net Order Imbalance Indicator dissemination from 3:50 p.m.

cells.zh: 混合模式：中央电子限价订单簿连续撮合，叠加竞争性做市商制度——任意数量会员机构可就同一证券登记为做市商，以自有账户在 Nasdaq 显示报价买卖并彼此竞争
cells.en: Hybrid: a central electronic limit order book with continuous matching, plus a competing market maker model — any number of member firms may register as market makers in a security and display two-sided quotes for their own account in competition with one another

cells.zh: 价格/时间优先撮合：同一价位按订单到达先后顺序执行；显示订单（displayed）优先于非展示订单（non-displayed）成交
cells.en: Price/time priority: displayed limit orders at the same price execute in the order received; non-displayed shares execute after displayed shares at that price

cells.zh: 限价单、市价单及多种细分类型与属性（Order Types Guide）：最小数量单（Minimum Quantity）、中点挂钩单（Mid-Point Peg）、非展示单（Non-Displayed）、只加单（Post Only）、自成交防范（Self Match Prevention）等；开盘 / 收盘另有 Opening / Closing Cross
cells.en: Limit and market orders plus a range of specialized types and attributes (see the Order Types Guide): Minimum Quantity, Mid-Point Peg, Non-Displayed, Post Only, and Self Match Prevention; the open and close use the Opening and Closing Crosses

cells.zh: 涨跌限价机制（LULD），以过去5分钟均价为基准动态计算价格区间，与us-nyse.yml记录的机制相同（同一份跨市场NMS Plan联合规则）
cells.en: Limit Up-Limit Down (LULD)

cells.zh: 常规时段（9:30am-3:35pm）按证券分层：Tier1（标普500/罗素1000/部分ETP，前收盘价>$3）5%；Tier2（其他NMS证券，前收盘价>$3）10%；前收盘价$0.75-3之间的Tier1&2证券20%；前收盘价低于$0.75者为$0.15或75%孰低。收盘前时段（3:35-4:00pm）各档带宽加倍（如Tier1变10%、$0.75-3档变40%）
cells.en: Tiered during Regular Hours (9:30am-3:35pm): Tier 1 (S&P 500/Russell 1000/select ETPs, prior close >$3) 5%; Tier 2 (other NMS securities, prior close >$3) 10%; Tier 1&2 securities priced $0.75-$3 use 20%; below $0.75 use the lesser of $0.15 or 75%. Bands double during the 3:35-4:00pm closing period

cells.zh: 全市场熔断（Market-Wide Circuit Breaker, MWCB），基于标普500指数单日跌幅：7%（一级）、13%（二级）、20%（三级）；与us-nyse.yml记录的机制相同（同一份跨市场联合计划）
cells.en: Market-Wide Circuit Breaker (MWCB) based on S&P 500 index decline: 7% (Level 1), 13% (Level 2), 20% (Level 3)

cells.zh: LULD个股级波动性中断：报价触及价格带边缘形成'Limit State'，持续15秒仍未消化即触发5分钟交易暂停
cells.en: LULD stock-level volatility interruption: an unresolved 15-second Limit State triggers a five-minute trading pause

cells.zh: 见circuit_breaker（全市场级MWCB）与volatility_interruption（个股级LULD）；另有因披露事项、系统故障等触发的监管性停牌，本次未逐条核实
cells.en: See circuit_breaker (market-wide MWCB) and volatility_interruption (stock-level LULD); regulatory halts (disclosure matters, technical issues, etc.) also exist but were not verified in detail this session

cells.zh: T+0（可当日回转），与结算层面T+1（见clearing.settlement_cycle）是两个不同概念
cells.en: T+0 (same-day round-trip trading allowed); distinct from the T+1 settlement cycle (see clearing.settlement_cycle)

cells.zh: 受Regulation SHO监管，含卖空限制熔断机制（Rule 201报升规则，Alternative Uptick Rule）：当某证券较其上一交易日常规交易时段收盘价（由其上市市场认定）下跌达10%或以上时触发，触发后当日剩余时段及次一交易日，卖空单价格须高于当前全国最优买价方可成交（展示卖空单在触发前已优于最优买价挂出的除外，另有标记为short exempt的例外情形）
cells.en: Regulated under Regulation SHO, including the short sale-related circuit breaker (Rule 201, Alternative Uptick Rule): triggered when a security's price decreases by 10% or more from its closing price on the prior day (as determined by its listing market), after which short sale orders for the remainder of that day and the following day may only execute at a price above the current national best bid (subject to exceptions for displayed orders already priced above the NBB before the trigger, and orders marked "short exempt")

cells.zh: 竞争性做市商制度：任意数量的会员机构均可就同一证券登记为做市商、彼此报价竞争（区别于NYSE的单一指定做市商DMM在同一证券上独占价格发现职责，见us-nyse.yml）
cells.en: Competing market maker model: any number of member firms may register as market makers in the same security and compete on quotes (contrasted with NYSE's single Designated Market Maker, see us-nyse.yml)

cells.zh: 披露为本，设有按市场层级分档的量化财务/流动性标准与统一的公司治理标准，由Listing Qualifications团队审核；与us-nyse.yml记录的NYSE审核制度属同一类型（美国交易所共有模式）
cells.en: Disclosure-based, with tiered quantitative financial/liquidity standards by market tier plus uniform corporate governance standards, reviewed by the Listing Qualifications team; structurally the same category as NYSE's review system (see us-nyse.yml)

cells.zh: 未达持续上市标准触发退市，如三档市场（Global Select/Global/Capital Market）项下最低买价均为1美元，低于该价格视为不达标
cells.en: Failure to meet continued listing standards, e.g. a minimum bid price of $1 across all three market tiers

cells.zh: T+1（2024年5月28日起，此前为T+2；此为SEC统一规则，适用于全国性证券交易所的多数经纪商交易，非纳斯达克自身单独设定）
cells.en: T+1 (effective May 28, 2024; previously T+2; a nationwide SEC rule applying to most broker-dealer transactions, not specific to Nasdaq)

cells.zh: 全国证券清算公司（National Securities Clearing Corporation, NSCC，DTCC子公司）
cells.en: National Securities Clearing Corporation (NSCC), a DTCC subsidiary

cells.zh: 不适用（现货市场，无实物/现金交割概念）
cells.en: Not applicable (cash market; no physical/cash delivery concept)

cells.zh: 做市商-吃单者模式（maker-taker）：为市场提供流动性的非展示订单可获返佣（如Tape C每股约$0.0005-0.0023区间，按月成交量与流动性类型分层），吃走流动性的一方付费；完整费率表按数十种精细条件分层
cells.en: Maker-taker pricing model

cells.zh: 公司制（2006年由会员制改制）
cells.en: Demutualized (2006)

cells.zh: 并非NYSE实体本身上市，而是其母公司洲际交易所（ICE）在纽交所上市（股票代码 ICE）
cells.en: Not NYSE itself; parent Intercontinental Exchange (ICE) is listed on NYSE

cells.zh: 美元 (USD)
cells.en: USD

cells.zh: 美元 (USD)
cells.en: USD

cells.zh: 美国证券交易委员会
cells.en: U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC)

cells.zh: NYSE Regulation（交易所自身的一线监管部门）；金融业监管局（FINRA）按监管服务协议代为执行部分跨市场执法工作
cells.en: NYSE Regulation; FINRA (via Regulatory Services Agreements)

cells.zh: 《1934年证券交易法》
cells.en: Securities Exchange Act of 1934

cells.zh: 开盘集合竞价（9:30am），由指定做市商（DMM）主持
cells.en: Core Open Auction, facilitated by the Designated Market Maker (DMM)

cells.zh: 收盘集合竞价（4:00pm），3:50-4:00pm为收盘失衡期
cells.en: Closing Auction, preceded by a Closing Imbalance Period

cells.zh: 混合模式：以中央电子限价订单簿（NYSE Pillar）连续撮合为主，叠加指定做市商（DMM）制度——每支股票指定一名 DMM 负责开盘、收盘及严重失衡期间的价格发现
cells.en: Hybrid: a central electronic limit order book (NYSE Pillar) with continuous matching, overlaid with the Designated Market Maker (DMM) system — each listed stock has one assigned DMM that facilitates price discovery at the open, at the close and during periods of substantial imbalance or instability

cells.zh: 开盘/收盘由DMM主持的集合竞价撮合，盘中为电子连续竞价撮合（NYSE Pillar系统）
cells.en: DMM-facilitated auctions at open/close; continuous electronic matching intraday via NYSE Pillar

cells.zh: 主要订单类型（Rule 7.31 Orders and Modifiers）：限价单（Limit Order）、市价单（Market Order）、非显示限价单（Non-Displayed Limit Order）、中点流动性单（MPL Order）、储备单（Reserve Order，部分显示 + 隐藏储备量）、盯住单（Pegged Order）；修饰符含 IOC、ALO（仅添加流动性）；开盘/收盘专用 LOO/LOC 及 D-Order
cells.en: Principal order types (Rule 7.31, Orders and Modifiers): Limit Order, Market Order, Non-Displayed Limit Order, Mid-Point Liquidity (MPL) Order, Reserve Order (partially displayed with non-displayed reserve), and Pegged Order; modifiers include IOC and ALO (Add Liquidity Only); the open and close additionally support Limit-on-Open/Close (LOO/LOC) and D-Orders

cells.zh: 涨跌限价机制（LULD），非固定百分比/绝对值幅，而是以过去5分钟均价为基准动态计算的价格带
cells.en: Limit Up-Limit Down (LULD)

cells.zh: 按Tier 1（标普500/罗素1000/部分ETP）与Tier 2（其余NMS证券）分级设定价格带百分比，具体档位数值本次未在抓取页面中找到
cells.en: Price bands are set by Tier 1 (S&P 500 / Russell 1000 / select ETPs) vs. Tier 2 (other NMS securities); the specific percentage figures were not found in the pages fetched this session

cells.zh: 全市场熔断（Market-Wide Circuit Breaker, MWCB），基于标普500指数单日跌幅触发三级阈值：7%（一级）、13%（二级）、20%（三级）；一、二级暂停交易 15 分钟，三级当日收市
cells.en: Market-Wide Circuit Breaker (MWCB)

cells.zh: 涨跌限价机制（LULD）本身即承担个股级波动性中断功能：价格持续处于价格带边缘会触发交易暂停
cells.en: LULD serves as the stock-level volatility interruption mechanism

cells.zh: 见 circuit_breaker（全市场级）与 volatility_interruption（LULD，个股级）；另有因披露事项的停牌（regulatory halt）未逐条核实
cells.en: See circuit_breaker (market-wide) and volatility_interruption (LULD, stock-level); regulatory halts for disclosure matters also exist but were not verified in detail this session

cells.zh: T+0（可当日回转），与结算层面的T+1（见 clearing.settlement_cycle）是两回事
cells.en: T+0 (same-day round-trip trading allowed); distinct from the T+1 settlement cycle (see clearing.settlement_cycle)

cells.zh: Regulation SHO第201条（'另类报升规则'/空头卖出熔断）：当某证券当日价格较前一交易日常规交易时段收盘价下跌10%或以上时，触发熔断，该证券自当时起至次一交易日收盘前，禁止以低于或等于当前全国最优买价（NBB）的价格执行或展示卖空订单
cells.en: Rule 201 of Regulation SHO (the "Alternative Uptick Rule" / short sale circuit breaker): once a covered security's price declines 10% or more intraday from its prior day's regular-trading-hours closing price, a circuit breaker is triggered, and for the remainder of that day and the following day, trading centers must prevent execution or display of a short sale order at a price at or below the current national best bid

cells.zh: 指定做市商制度（DMM）：每支股票指定一名DMM，负责在开盘、收盘及严重失衡/不稳定期间维持价格发现
cells.en: Designated Market Maker (DMM)

cells.zh: 披露为本（非注册制/核准制二分），设有量化+定性双重上市标准，由Issuer Regulation团队审核
cells.en: Disclosure-based (not a simple registration/approval binary); combines quantitative and qualitative listing standards, reviewed by the Issuer Regulation team

cells.zh: 未达持续上市定量/定性标准触发退市；具体阈值（如最低股价规则）本次未逐条核实
cells.en: Non-compliance with quantitative or qualitative continued listing standards
T+1 (effective May 28, 2024; previously T+2)

cells.zh: 全国证券清算公司（National Securities Clearing Corporation, NSCC），DTCC旗下子公司；对涉及股票、公司债与市政债、美国存托凭证、交易所买卖基金及单位投资信托的几乎所有经纪商间交易提供中央对手方（CCP）服务
cells.en: National Securities Clearing Corporation (NSCC), a subsidiary of DTCC; serves as the CCP for virtually all broker-to-broker trades involving equities, corporate and municipal debt, American depositary receipts, exchange-traded funds, and unit investment trusts

cells.zh: 存管信托公司（The Depository Trust Company, DTC），DTCC旗下子公司；为美国证券交易提供中央证券存管（CSD）服务，覆盖股票、认股权证、公司债券及票据、市政债券、政府证券、资产支持证券、存托凭证及货币市场工具等多类合格证券
cells.en: The Depository Trust Company (DTC), a subsidiary of DTCC; provides central securities depository (CSD) services for U.S. securities transactions across eligible security types including equities, warrants, rights, corporate debt and notes, municipal bonds, government securities, asset-backed securities, depositary receipts, and money market instruments

cells.zh: 不适用（现货市场，无实物/现金交割概念）
cells.en: Not applicable (cash market; no physical/cash delivery concept)

cells.zh: 做市商-吃单者模式（maker-taker）：为市场提供流动性的报单可获返佣（如每股0.0012美元量级），吃走流动性的一方付费；费率按会员机构的报价/成交量分层，逐月计算
cells.en: Maker-taker pricing model

cells.zh: 公司制且自身上市——2005年由会员制改制为股份有限公司，并在自身运营的主板挂牌
cells.en: Demutualized and self-listed — converted from a member-owned mutual association to a company in 2005, and listed on the main board it operates

cells.zh: 是，JSE Limited自身股票代码为JSE，ISIN为ZAE000079711，在其运营的主板挂牌交易
cells.en: Yes — JSE Limited's own share code is JSE (ISIN ZAE000079711), listed on the Main Board it operates

cells.zh: 南非兰特（ZAR）
cells.en: South African Rand (ZAR)

cells.zh: 南非兰特（ZAR），与交易货币一致
cells.en: South African rand (ZAR), same as the trading currency

cells.zh: 金融部门行为监管局（Financial Sector Conduct Authority，FSCA）——南非「双峰」（Twin Peaks）监管架构下负责市场行为监管的机构
cells.en: Financial Sector Conduct Authority (FSCA) — the market-conduct regulator under South Africa's Twin Peaks framework

cells.zh: JSE自身兼具前线监管职能：设Issuer Regulation（发行人监管）与Market Regulation（市场监管）两个内部部门，负责上市审核、持续监管、成员合规与市场纪律，重大规则修订与授权则需FMA框架下向FSCA备案/批准
cells.en: The JSE itself performs front-line regulation via its internal Issuer Regulation and Market Regulation divisions (listing review, continuing obligations, member compliance and market discipline), with major rule changes and authorisations subject to FSCA oversight under the FMA

cells.zh: 《金融市场法》（Financial Markets Act No.19 of 2012，经历次修订）
cells.en: Financial Markets Act No. 19 of 2012, as amended

cells.zh: 开盘集合竞价（Opening Auction Call，08:30–09:00），订单可提交/撤销/修改，竞价结束时按成交量最大化算法（Volume Maximising Algorithm）统一定价撮合
cells.en: Opening Auction Call (08:30–09:00); orders may be entered, cancelled or amended, with the uncrossing price determined by the Volume Maximising Algorithm

cells.zh: 收盘集合竞价（Closing Auction Call，16:50–17:00），同样按成交量最大化算法撮合定价；不同交易分段收盘价计算方法不同（如ZA01/ZA02/ZA03用成交量加权平均价VWAP法，ZA04/ZA06用中间价Mid-point法）
cells.en: Closing Auction Call (16:50–17:00), also uncrossed via the Volume Maximising Algorithm; the closing-price methodology varies by segment (e.g. ZA01/ZA02/ZA03 use VWAP, ZA04/ZA06 use a mid-point method)

cells.zh: 订单驱动：中央电子限价订单簿，按价格-可见性-时间优先原则连续撮合；主板与 AltX 普通股无强制做市商要求，仅专项证券（ETF / ETN / 权证 / 结构性产品等）设做市商制度以提供流动性
cells.en: Order-driven: a central electronic limit order book matching on price-visibility-time priority; there is no mandatory market-maker requirement for ordinary Main Board or AltX equities, and market makers exist only for specialist securities (ETFs, ETNs, warrants, structured products, etc.) to provide liquidity

cells.zh: 中央订单簿按价格-可见性-时间优先原则连续撮合：会员在同等条件下竞争成交，同价位隐藏单排在可见单之后成交
cells.en: Central order book matching on strict price-visibility-time priority; members compete on equal terms, with hidden orders yielding priority to visible orders at the same price

cells.zh: 市价单（Market Order）、限价单（Limit Order）、止损单（Stop Order）、止损限价单（Stop Limit Order）、钉住隐藏单/钉住隐藏限价单（Pegged Hidden Order / Pegged Hidden Limit Order）、冰山单（Iceberg Order）
cells.en: Market Order, Limit Order, Stop Order, Stop Limit Order, Pegged Hidden Order / Pegged Hidden Limit Order, and Iceberg Order

cells.zh: 双阈值百分比机制：以前收盘价为基准的静态参考价（Static Reference Price）与以最新成交价动态更新的动态参考价（Dynamic Reference Price）各设独立的百分比容忍阈值，任一阈值被突破即触发波动性拍卖（不是直接拒单的固定涨跌停）
cells.en: Dual percentage-band mechanism: independent tolerance percentages are set against a Static Reference Price (previous close, updated after each auction) and a Dynamic Reference Price (last traded price); breaching either triggers a Volatility Auction rather than an outright order rejection

cells.zh: 以ZA01分段（Top40成分股等流动性最好的品种）为例：连续交易静态阈值±10%/动态阈值±3%；开盘/收盘/重开集合竞价阶段静态±8%/动态±6%；期货到期收盘（FCO）阶段静态±15%/动态±2%
cells.en: For Segment ZA01 (Top40 constituents and other highly liquid instruments): Continuous Trading Static ±10% / Dynamic ±3%; Opening/Closing/Re-Opening Auction Calls Static ±8% / Dynamic ±6%; Futures Close-Out Auction Call Static ±15% / Dynamic ±2%

cells.zh: 个股/品种级熔断（非指数级）：静态或动态参考价容忍阈值被突破后，该品种自动转入5分钟的波动性拍卖冷静期（Volatility Auction Call），非全市场停牌。未找到与美股MWCB或港交所整体停市式的独立全市场级熔断机制，与jp-jpx/de-eurex此前遇到的同类未确认情况类似，不确定是否本次检索范围局限
cells.en: Instrument-level circuit breaker (not index-level): breaching the static or dynamic reference-price tolerance moves the instrument into a 5-minute Volatility Auction Call, not an exchange-wide halt. No evidence of a separate market-wide circuit breaker (akin to U.S. MWCB) was found in the content fetched this round — similar to the unresolved status previously noted for jp-jpx/de-eurex, this may reflect the limits of this session's search rather than a confirmed absence

cells.zh: 波动性拍卖冷静期（Volatility Auction Call Session）：持续5分钟，可能追加1次2分钟的市价单延期（Market Order Extension），随后进入最长30秒的随机撮合窗口完成集合竞价定价
cells.en: Volatility Auction Call Session: lasts 5 minutes, may be followed by one 2-minute Market Order Extension, then a random period of up to 30 seconds before the auction uncrossing

cells.zh: 人工停牌（Halt Session）：由JSE市场运营人员手动触发，可针对全市场/交易分段/单一品种；恢复交易通过手动触发的重开集合竞价（Re-Opening Auction Call Session）完成
cells.en: Manually invoked Halt Session, triggered by JSE Market Operations at the market/segment/instrument level; resumption is via a manually invoked Re-Opening Auction Call Session

cells.zh: JSE 现货市场允许当日回转交易（T+0）：当日买入的证券可于同一交易日卖出，无类似 A 股的 T+1 锁定；后端结算为 T+3（见 clearing.settlement_cycle），但交易层面不受结算周期限制。
cells.en: The JSE cash market permits intraday round-trip trading (T+0): securities bought on a given day can be sold on the same day, with no A-share-style T+1 lock; back-office settlement is T+3 (see clearing.settlement_cycle), but trading is not constrained by the settlement cycle.

cells.zh: 允许备兑卖空（covered short selling），禁止裸卖空（naked short selling）：客户下达卖空指令、会员向JSE交易系统录入卖空订单或报告卖空成交前，须满足证券已实际持有（非证书化形式，由会员或客户的CSDP托管）、已有另一笔交易将取得该证券、已落实借券安排、公司行动将产生该证券、或证券将从境外登记簿过户至本地登记簿等条件之一
cells.en: Covered short selling is permitted; naked short selling is prohibited. Before a client places a short-sell order or a member enters/reports one, the securities must be secured via one of: uncertificated holding with the member's/client's CSDP, another transaction that will yield the securities, a satisfactory borrowing arrangement, a corporate action, or transfer from a foreign register

cells.zh: 专项证券（ETF/AMETF/ETN/AMC/权证/结构性产品）设有做市商制度以提供流动性，是该类产品发行人获准挂牌的重要考量之一；现货股票主板/AltX普通股本身未见强制做市商要求的证据
cells.en: Specialist Securities (ETFs/AMETFs/ETNs/AMCs/warrants/structured products) rely on market makers for liquidity provision, a key consideration for issuers; no evidence of a mandatory market-maker requirement was found for ordinary Main Board/AltX equities

cells.zh: 以量化财务与股权分布门槛为主的交易所审核制：主板/AltX各设明确的利润、净资产、发行股数、公众持股比例等量化标准，达标申请由交易所审核后授予上市；同时保留对开发阶段公司、地产实体、矿业/油气公司、投资实体、SPAC等多类特殊申请人的例外条款与自由裁量权
cells.en: Exchange-led review anchored in quantitative financial and shareholder-spread thresholds (profit, net asset value, issued shares, free float) for the Main Board and AltX, with the JSE granting listings to compliant applicants while retaining discretionary exemptions for development-stage companies, property entities, mining/oil & gas companies, investment entities and SPACs

cells.zh: JSE可在下列情形之一移除证券上市：不合规于《上市规则》；证券持有人已批准除牌（须至少75%到会表决权同意，另须提供公平意见书）；要约收购方依《公司法》第124条意图除牌；依《公司法》第114/115条完成安排计划且JSE认为发行人已不再符合上市条件；或证券按条款赎回——除牌前须先经暂停程序
cells.en: The JSE may remove a listing where: the issuer breaches the Requirements; securities holders have approved removal (requiring at least 75% of votes cast, plus a fairness opinion); an offeror intends removal via a takeover offer under Companies Act s.124; a scheme of arrangement under ss.114/115 is completed and the JSE is satisfied the issuer no longer qualifies; or securities are redeemed per their terms — removal must first be preceded by suspension

cells.zh: T+3（2016年起，此前为T+5）：卖方交付证券换取现金（DvP），买方支付现金换取证券（RvP），经JSE指定的中央证券存管机构Strate处理，实现同步、终局、不可撤销的券款对付（SFIDvP）
cells.en: T+3 (since 2016, down from T+5): sellers deliver securities against cash receipt (DvP) and buyers receive securities against cash payment (RvP), processed through Strate (the JSE-appointed CSD), achieving simultaneous, final, irrevocable delivery versus payment (SFIDvP)

cells.zh: 现货证券市场无传统意义上的中央对手方净额担保安排，而是由JSE结算权威机构（JSE Settlement Authority）通过多层结算保障机制（"防线"：会员准入门槛、每日资本充足监控、CSDP承诺、保证金、违约处置流程）提供结算保障，非CCP novation模式；衍生品市场则设有独立的中央对手方JSE Clear（JSE全资子公司，2022年9月1日起持有FSCA/PA/SARB联合颁发的独立结算所与CCP牌照）
cells.en: The cash equity market has no traditional CCP novation arrangement — instead, the JSE Settlement Authority provides settlement assurance through multiple "lines of defence" (membership entry requirements, daily capital-adequacy monitoring, CSDP commits, margin, default-management process). Derivatives markets instead have a dedicated CCP, JSE Clear (a wholly owned JSE subsidiary, licensed as an independent clearing house and CCP by the FSCA jointly with the PA/SARB since 1 September 2022)

cells.zh: 证券存管中心Strate Limited，南非法定的中央证券存管机构与中央质押品平台
cells.en: Strate Limited, South Africa's principal central securities depository (CSD) and central collateral platform

cells.zh: 现货证券交割为无纸化记账过户（经Strate电子结算），不适用实物/现金交割二选一；衍生品部分另见 clearing.derivatives.delivery_method
cells.en: Cash equities settle via dematerialised book-entry transfer through Strate — not applicable to a physical/cash delivery choice; for derivatives see clearing.derivatives.delivery_method

cells.zh: JSE 对权益交易（含权证、ETP、AltX）按每笔成交金额的 0.50 个基点计收交易费，并设单笔成交上限（trade cap，见 detail）。
cells.en: The JSE charges a trading fee of 0.50 basis points of the value of each trade leg on equity trades (including warrants, ETPs and AltX), subject to a per-trade ceiling (trade cap, see detail).

cells.zh: 证券转让税（Securities Transfer Tax，STT）：税率0.25%，适用于上市与未上市证券的每一次转让，2008年7月1日起依《证券转让税法》（No.25 of 2007）及其征管法（No.26 of 2007）施行，取代原印花税制度。征收方向为买方：SARS 明示上市证券经会员/参与者转让时，会员/参与者为法定纳税人，但『可向受让证券的人追偿应缴税款』（即买方最终承担）；非经会员持有的其他上市证券转让，则『受让证券的人负有纳税义务』。
cells.en: Securities Transfer Tax (STT): levied at 0.25% on every transfer of a security (listed or unlisted), effective 1 July 2008 under the Securities Transfer Tax Act No. 25 of 2007 and its Administration Act No. 26 of 2007, replacing the former stamp duty regime. The incidence is buy-side: SARS states that where listed securities are transferred through or from a member or participant, the member or participant is liable but 'may recover the tax payable from the persons to whom the securities were transferred' (i.e. borne by the buyer/transferee); for other listed securities the person to whom the security is transferred is liable.
